## DLC_MEGACORP_RECOMMENDATION_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADLC_MEGACORP_RECOMMENDATION_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§S《Megacorp》§!是一个以经济为重心的扩展包，为商业带来更多的复杂性，帮助你在竞争激烈的市场中获得优势。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3`

### English

## PLANET_HOUSING_NO_HAPPINESS_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APLANET_HOUSING_NO_HAPPINESS_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$代表着住家、公寓、以及各种可以容纳居民的建筑和设施。无法满足其人口住房需求的殖民地将会受到$r_stability$方面的惩罚。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:39`

### English

§E$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$ represents homes, apartments and other infrastructure dedicated to housing its inhabitants. A Colony that does not meet the Housing needs of its drone population will suffer penalties to $r_stability$.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:39`

## PLANET_STABILITY_NO_HAPPINESS_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APLANET_STABILITY_NO_HAPPINESS_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§t§H稳定度§!是量化殖民地上的工作单位整体效率的指标。该指标主要受影响于所有子个体对于§H$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$§!和§H$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§!的基础需求是否得到满足。\n\n拥有高$PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$的殖民地会获得资源生产加成，而拥有低$PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$的殖民地则会受到惩罚，甚至会引发诸如全面§H叛乱§!（如果殖民地上有非格式塔人口的存在）等负面事件。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:44`

### English

§t§HStability§! is a measure of the overall functionality of the drone population on the colony. It is primarily determined by ensuring that all drones have their basic needs for §H$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$§! and §H$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§! fulfilled.\n\nA colony with high $PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$ will have increased resource production, while a colony with low $PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$ will suffer penalties and may experience negative events or even a full-scale §HRevolt§! if there are non-drone Pops present on the colony.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:44`

## PLANET_CRIME_NO_HAPPINESS_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APLANET_CRIME_NO_HAPPINESS_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§t§H反常度§!是£colony£ ['concept_colony']上总体的异常和违抗行为水平的量化指标。\n\n高§H反常度§!会导致殖民地上发生负面事件甚至降低行星的£stability£ ['concept_stability']。\n\n庞大的人口天然产生反常度，而雇佣£job_patrol_drone£ §H$job_patrol_drone_plural$§!则可以降低它。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:59`

### English

§t§HDeviancy§! is a measure of the overall level of anomalous behavior and non-compliance of a £colony£ ['concept_colony'].\n\nA high level of §HDeviancy§! causes negative events to occur on the colony and may reduce £stability£ ['concept_stability'].\n\nIt is naturally caused by having a large population, and can be reduced by employing £job_patrol_drone£ §H$job_patrol_drone_plural$§!.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:59`

### 中文

## FORCED_ASSEMBLY_UNSET_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFORCED_ASSEMBLY_UNSET_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

撤销掉当前所设置的优先机械物种，允许任何合法的机械物种在$PLANET|Y$上组建。选择被组装的人口会立刻被重新计算。\n\n如果组装的人口是在§Y有机§!与§Y机械§!人口之间切换，那么此举将消耗我们§R100%§!的现有组装进度。相反，如果新选择的物种只是与现在的不同，我们将只损失$VALUE|0%R$的进度。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:220`

### English

Remove the currently prioritized species, allowing for the assembly of any valid species on $PLANET|Y$. The choice of species to be assembled will immediately be re-evaluated.\n\nIf a switch from §Yorganic§! to §Yrobotic§! pop assembly or vice versa is made as a result, this will cost us §R100%§! of our current assembly progress. Otherwise, if the newly-picked species is different to the current one, $VALUE|0%R$ of our progress will be lost.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:236`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:221`

### English

### 中文

§E§Y移民§!代表着殖民地人口迁入和迁出的总体水平。人口迁入中的殖民地人口增长速度较快，人口迁出中的殖民地人口增长速度会下降，但可以促进其他殖民地的发展壮大。§!

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOP_ASSEMBLY_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$POP_ASSEMBLY_TITLE$代表着殖民地人工制造新人口的总能力。对于大部分类型的帝国来说，人口组装来自于[roboticist.GetIcon]§Y[roboticist.GetName]§!等岗位，用于组装£pop£ §Y机械人口§!，但蜂巢思维和特定克隆装置可以自己组装活体人口。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:495`

### English

§E$POP_ASSEMBLY_TITLE$ represents the total capacity the colony has to artificially create new pops. For most types of empires, Pop Assembly comes from [roboticist.GetIcon] §Y[roboticist.GetName]§! jobs and is used to build £pop£ §YRobot Pops§!, but Organic Pop Assembly in Hives or from certain cloning facilities can build living creatures.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:521`

## concept_denizen_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aconcept_denizen_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H居民§!是帝国中最普普通通的居住者。他们在这个庞大的系统中居住、工作，却又没有占据任何权力地位或特殊智能。无论是生为一具血肉、一段代码或是集体意志，他们都是这个文明的培养基。\n\n§H平民§!和§H维护子个体§!是两种典型的§H居民§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:766`

### English

§HDenizens§! are the everyday inhabitants of an empire. Those who live, work, and exist within its vast systems without holding positions of power or specialization. Whether born of flesh, code, or collective will, they are the living substrate of civilization.\n\n§HCivilians§! and §HMaintenance Drones§! are examples of §HDenizens§!.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:811`

宇宙环境效应揭示了时空丝缕如何包含每个维度的秘密。这些研究人员孜孜不倦地破译它们的意义，同时尽量减少悖论。

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ajob_noble_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

贵族的负担是非常沉重的，他们天生的使命就是领导平庸的同胞们。幸运的是如此艰苦的岗位能够换来相当优渥的生活，所以此岗位还是非常让人趋之若鹜。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:1568`

他们买入他们卖出。他们囤货他们转售。他们是代理商也是经销商，他们是零售商又是批发商——总之有交易的地方，就有商人。

### 中文

最新最棒的老虎机现已推出，人们玩到根本停不下来！这些老虎机会控制人们的大脑，直到榨干他们的钱财为止。

## tech_mine_volatile_motes_desc

### 中文

我们需要收集的易爆微粒性质十分不稳定，采集工作也危险重重。为了不在该过程中引起连环爆炸，需要使用能量场对微粒进行稳定化。

### English

Volatile Motes are fickle particles that are dangerous to work with. In order to safely harvest them without setting off a chain-reaction of explosions, energy fields must be used to stabilize the motes.

### 中文

当我们走出家园，漫游星海的同时，我们的经济也进入了一个全新的时代。新的市场正以惊人的速度涌现，使得经济学家们措手不及。

对全息技术进行别出心裁的运用，造成了崭新的人工虚拟环境，其真实程度令人赞叹。这乃是沉浸式虚拟现实娱乐的一大进步。

这到底是拜金神教的预知能力真的生效了？还是只是精密的计算方式的成果？无论如何，这个星际股市推算模型真的可以准确地推算出金融市场的走向。

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_nanosands_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这颗行星上绵延不绝的沙丘居然全部由纳米机器人构成。这些机器人的内部结构早已破败不堪，无法重新激活，但却为我们提供了能覆盖整个星球的稀有金属颗粒。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2350`

### English

The sand dunes on this planet are almost entirely composed of countless broken nanites. Their structure is degraded far beyond any chance for reactivation, but they do coat the planet in rare metal granulate.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2566`

### 中文

潮湿的苔藓、地衣、以及菌类犹如给这片崎岖的山地覆盖上了一层绿色的地毯。

### English

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_fungal_caves_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这些广阔的洞窟网络生长着各种各样的可食用菌菇，它们不需要任何阳光或肥沃土壤依然能够茁壮成长。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2388`

### English

## d_fungal_forest

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_fungal_forest&lang=en)

### 中文

菌落森林

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2389`

### English

Fungal Forest

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2607`

## d_fungal_forest_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_fungal_forest_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2390`

### English

In lieu of trees, towering mushrooms dominate these fecund forests, the enormous caps of fungal giants blotting out sunlight to create the perfect environment for a rich variety of smaller specimens.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2608`

## d_fertile_lands

## d_black_soil

## d_scandinavian_reclamation_sector_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_scandinavian_reclamation_sector_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

22世纪末进行的大型恢复再开发行动十分有效，除了几处最为顽固的放射区域以外，其它区域都已经恢复了正常。核泄漏事件以来的基因突变率已降至最低点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2425`

### English

Reclamation efforts in the late 22nd century eliminated all but the most stubborn pockets of radiation, and mutation levels are now at an all-time low since the Containment Breach.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2646`

## d_saharan_irrigation_project

## d_saharan_irrigation_project_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_saharan_irrigation_project_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当年绿色撒哈拉行动刚刚被提出时，伊兹奎多教授受到了各界的冷嘲热讽……但现在应该已经没人记得了吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2427`

## d_mesopotamian_urban_corridor_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_mesopotamian_urban_corridor_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

几乎遍及整个新月沃地的这个巨大都市，其本身就是对文明发源之地的致敬。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2429`

### English

The megalopolis that stretches along most of the Fertile Crescent is in itself a monument to this ancient birthplace of civilization.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2650`

## d_boswash_metropolitan_axis_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_boswash_metropolitan_axis_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

波士顿-华盛顿暴动给整整一代人留下了难以抚平的创伤。也正是因为如此，才引致了大刀阔斧的法律改革。永远不要忘记前人的牺牲！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2431`

### English

The BosWash Riots traumatized an entire generation and led to sweeping legal reforms. Never Forget!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2652`

### English

## d_mauritanian_security_zone_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_mauritanian_security_zone_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在这里，铁切尔上校和他余下寥寥的兵士们进行了他们世界闻名的背水一战。直到现在，也偶尔会在此处发现当年没有爆炸的哑弹。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2433`

### English

Unexploded munitions are still occasionally found near the compound where Colonel Tetchu and the remnants of his brigade made their famous last stand.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2654`

## d_great_albertan_crater

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_great_albertan_crater&lang=en)

### 中文

阿尔伯塔巨型陨石坑

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2434`

### English

Great Albertan Crater

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2655`

## d_great_albertan_crater_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_great_albertan_crater_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当萨蒂斯711494号迫近地球的消息传来时，造成了72年的大规模恐慌事件。每个人都认为地球大限已至——该来的最终还是来了。幸运的是，萨蒂斯711494号的体积并没有大到摧毁整个地球，但阿尔伯塔的大半部分还是不幸从地图上被抹去了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2435`

### English

When 711494 Satis approached Earth and triggered the Great Panic of '72, everyone thought this was it - the Big One had finally arrived. Fortunately, it wasn't big enough to cause an extinction event. Unfortunately, it wiped out much of Alberta.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2656`

## d_pacific_algae_tracts

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_pacific_algae_tracts_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

只有潜到海底才能看到的壮观景象。好似能一直蔓延下去，没有尽头。

## d_delhi_sprawl_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_delhi_sprawl_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

直到22世纪末，吉祥天商业高塔一直是地球上最高的建筑。其特殊的造型直到现在都是德里城区一道独特的风景。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2439`

### English

Lakshmi Commerce Tower was the tallest building on Earth for the better part of the 22nd century, and its unique shape remains an iconic feature of the Delhi skyline.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2660`

## d_pearl_river_agglomerate

## d_pearl_river_agglomerate_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_pearl_river_agglomerate_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

珠江区域是地球上第一个被正式归类为巨型都市的地区。在此处发扬光大的金三角防污染政策将会被世界各地的大型城市所相继运用。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2441`

### English

The first region on Earth to be officially designated a megacity. Several other developing urban regions would eventually adopt their own versions of the Golden Delta's successful anti-pollution policies.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2662`

这个世界的迁徙森林频繁集体迁移到新的地区，破坏建设好的道路，输电线路和其他基础设施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2448`

### English

The mobile forests of this world frequently migrate en masse to new regions, disrupting efforts at building roads, power lines and other infrastructure.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2671`

## d_migrating_forest_reserve

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_migrating_forest_reserve&lang=en)

### 中文

迁徙森林护林区

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2449`

### English

Migrating Forest Reserve

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2672`

## d_migrating_forest_reserve_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_migrating_forest_reserve_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这整个地区被隔离以供迁徙森林生长。它们可以在这里安全地生活，不用担心对城市造成任何破坏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2450`

### English

This entire region has been set aside for the migrating forests that are native to this world. Here they can roam in peace, without causing damage to urban areas.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2673`

## d_junk_wastes

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_junk_wastes&lang=en)

### 中文

垃圾废土

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2451`

### English

Junk Wastes

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2674`

## d_junk_wastes_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_junk_wastes_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个垃圾场无边无际，偶尔还能看见拔地而起的巨大废料。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2452`

### English

The wastes stretch as far as one can see, with occasional pieces of larger junk jutting up out of the ground.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2675`

## d_junk_canals

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_junk_canals&lang=en)

### 中文

垃圾沟渠

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2453`

### English

Junk Canals

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2676`

## d_junk_canals_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_junk_canals_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一道道狭窄的小溪串流在垃圾场中，导致局部土壤异常肥沃。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2454`

### English

These narrow canals snake around the junk piles, and some of the adjacent soil is surprisingly fertile.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2677`

## d_junk_hollows

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_junk_hollows&lang=en)

### 中文

垃圾洞窟

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2455`

### English

Junk Hollows

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2678`

## d_junk_hollows_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_junk_hollows_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这些垃圾堆下的地底洞窟很适合用来建设反应堆。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2456`

### English

These hollows deep beneath the surface junk would serve well as isolated reactor chambers.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2679`

## d_irradiated_valley

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_irradiated_valley&lang=en)

### 中文

辐射山谷

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2457`

### English

Irradiated Valley

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2680`

## d_irradiated_valley_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_irradiated_valley_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一场辐射量爆表的太阳耀斑横扫了这个偏僻的山谷。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2458`

### English

A solar flare has washed this isolated valley with heavy radiation.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2681`

## d_valley_of_zanaam

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_valley_of_zanaam&lang=en)

### 中文

扎娜姆之谷

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2459`

### English

Valley of Zanaam

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2682`

## d_valley_of_zanaam_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_valley_of_zanaam_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这山谷之中矗立着十分神秘的石碑，上面刻满了已经不再流通的外星语言。靠近石碑时，能够感觉到充满能量波动的低鸣声，同时会感受到头痛。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2460`

### English

This valley is home to a mysterious obelisk that is covered in letters from a dead alien language. It hums with power and those in its proximity suffer headaches.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2683`

## d_abandoned_primitive_homesteads

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_abandoned_primitive_homesteads&lang=en)

### 中文

废弃的宅地

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2461`

### English

Abandoned Homesteads

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2684`

## d_abandoned_primitive_homesteads_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_abandoned_primitive_homesteads_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这片被遗弃的宅地曾经居住着一种爬行类物种。虽然他们依然存在于此行星上，但是现已退化成非智能生物了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2462`

### English

These abandoned homesteads were once inhabited by a society of reptiles. They still populate the planet, but have since lost all capacity for sapient though.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2685`

## d_the_zone

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_the_zone&lang=en)

### 中文

区域A

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2463`

### English

Zone A

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2686`

## d_the_zone_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_the_zone_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这座星球上有片十三公里见方的区域，散布着起源未知的遗迹，以及许多古怪而独特的异星造物。令人困惑的是，它同时也使到访者产生心满意足的情绪。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2464`

### English

A thirteen-by-thirteen kilometer stretch of land on this planet is a ruin of unknown origin, littered with many bizarre and unique alien artifacts. Bafflingly, it also produces sensations of deep contentment in its visitors.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2687`

## d_hyperfertile_valley

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_hyperfertile_valley&lang=en)

### 中文

异常肥沃的山谷

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2465`

### English

Hyperfertile Valley

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2688`

## d_hyperfertile_valley_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_hyperfertile_valley_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这片山谷的土壤非常肥沃，因此遍布着各种青葱的植物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2466`

### English

The soil in this valley is extremely fertile, and it is covered in intense greenery.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2689`

## d_ancient_mining_site

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_ancient_mining_site&lang=en)

### 中文

远古矿井

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2467`

### English

Ancient Mining Site

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2690`

## d_ancient_mining_site_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_ancient_mining_site_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个古代矿场虽然年代久远，但是大部分采矿设备依然可以正常运作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2468`

### English

The site of an ancient mining operation. Despite its age, much of the equipment can still be operated.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2691`

## d_toy_factory_complex

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_toy_factory_complex&lang=en)

### 中文

玩具工厂建筑群

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2469`

### English

Toy Factory Complex

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2692`

## d_toy_factory_complex_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_toy_factory_complex_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

不停运作的大型工厂，将高分子聚合物塑造成形状各异而用途未知小物件。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2470`

### English

Complex machinery ceaselessly molds complex polymers into small items of varying shapes and inscrutable purpose.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2693`

## d_mutant_landfill

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_mutant_landfill&lang=en)

### 中文

突变体填埋场

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2471`

### English

Mutant Landfill

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2694`

## d_mutant_landfill_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_mutant_landfill_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

死去的突变体堆叠在一起构成恐怖的景象。不稳定的有机物质扭曲在一起，形成了某种结构。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2472`

### English

A putrid mass of dead mutated horrors. Their volatile organic matter has twisted together to form a structure of sorts.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2695`

## d_ancient_bombardment_craters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_ancient_bombardment_craters&lang=en)

### 中文

远古轰炸弹坑

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2473`

### English

Ancient Bombardment Craters

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2696`

## d_ancient_bombardment_craters_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_ancient_bombardment_craters_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

此行星在无数年前曾遭遇过猛烈的轨道轰炸。地面上依然遍布着轰炸所产生的巨坑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2474`

### English

This world was subjected to intense orbital bombardment long ago. Parts of the surface are still pockmarked with impact craters.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2697`

## d_ancient_battlefield

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_ancient_battlefield&lang=en)

### 中文

古战场

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2475`

### English

Ancient Battlefield

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2698`

## d_ancient_battlefield_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_ancient_battlefield_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

此行星上曾经存在过某种文明，但是被外来的异星势力摧毁了。这个遍布残骸的古代战场诉说着他们绝望的挣扎。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2476`

### English

The civilization that once inhabited this world was destroyed by an invading force from somewhere beyond their solar system. This ancient battlefield is littered with ancient debris from their desperate last stand.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2699`

## d_irradiated_ruins

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_irradiated_ruins&lang=en)

### 中文

辐射废墟

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2477`

### English

Irradiated Ruins

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2700`

## d_irradiated_ruins_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_irradiated_ruins_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

生存在这个星球上的两个超级大国间曾经爆发了一场大型核战，这就是战争留下的废墟。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2478`

### English

Remnants from a massive nuclear war waged by the two global superpowers that once inhabited this world.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2701`

## d_impact_crater

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_impact_crater&lang=en)

### 中文

陨石坑

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2479`

### English

Impact Crater

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2702`

## d_impact_crater_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_impact_crater_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

大型陨石坠落到地面所产生的陨石坑。坑中残留着陨石上的矿物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2480`

### English

A crater from a large meteor impact. Minerals from the meteor itself can still be found at the site.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2703`

## d_odd_factory

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_odd_factory&lang=en)

### 中文

古怪工厂

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2481`

### English

Odd Factory

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2704`

## d_odd_factory_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_odd_factory_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

十分精妙的工厂，似乎是某个文明遗留在这个星球上的。可以生产珍贵资源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2482`

### English

A well-crafted facility that produces high value resources, left on the planet by a different civilization.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2705`

## d_ancient_particle_accelerator

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_ancient_particle_accelerator&lang=en)

### 中文

远古粒子加速器

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2487`

### English

Ancient Particle Accelerator

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2710`

## d_ancient_particle_accelerator_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_ancient_particle_accelerator_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

十分古老的粒子加速器，其构造却很有新意。从还能够运行的部件中可以获取大量研究资料。这些资料一定是由某个天才物理学家收集整合的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2488`

### English

This old particle accelerator was built using a novel design, and the surviving terminals within the structure contain a massive amount of research data composed by what must have been a brilliant theoretical physicist.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2711`

## d_underground_vault

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_underground_vault&lang=en)

### 中文

地下避难所

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2489`

### English

Underground Vault

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2712`

## d_underground_vault_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_underground_vault_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

面积巨大的地下避难所，应该是被这个星球的原住民用来当做防空洞的。不过在储存的食物耗尽后，这些原住民就开始互相残杀了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2490`

### English

A massive underground vault, intended as a bomb shelter by this world's original inhabitants. The vault's occupants turned on each other when their food ran out.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2713`

## d_underground_vault_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_underground_vault_2&lang=en)

### 中文

$d_underground_vault$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2491`

### English

$d_underground_vault$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2714`

## d_underground_vault_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_underground_vault_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

面积巨大的地下避难所，应该是被这个星球的原住民用来当做防空洞的。避难所中有着庞大的机械园区以及大量的挖掘装备。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2492`

### English

A massive underground vault, intended as a bomb shelter by this world's original inhabitants. The vault contains a huge machine park along with stores of mining equipment.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2715`

## d_cryonic_clones

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_cryonic_clones&lang=en)

### 中文

冷冻克隆人纪念碑

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2493`

### English

Cryonic Clones Monument

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2716`

## d_cryonic_clones_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_cryonic_clones_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当这个环形世界仍然是废墟的时候，有几百个外星克隆生物被封存在冷冻保存仓之中。现在这些被修复的冷冻仓成为了一所纪念碑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2494`

### English

Hundreds of alien clones were left sealed in cryostasis chambers when this Ring World was still a ruin. Now fully restored, the clones have been preserved in this monument.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2717`

## d_flooded_mounds

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_flooded_mounds&lang=en)

### 中文

被淹没的丘穴

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2495`

### English

Flooded Mounds

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2718`

## d_flooded_mounds_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_flooded_mounds_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在这个世界的深海底部可以发现上千个互相连接着的丘穴，如同巨大的白蚁群落所构建的一般。其实这里是远古智慧节肢动物所留下来的遗迹。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2496`

### English

Thousands upon thousands of interconnected termite-like mounds can be found far beneath the ocean on this world, the last remnants of an ancient species of sapient arthropoids.

## d_processing_pens_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_processing_pens_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该星球土生土长的真菌类生物经过基因工程改造后，变得十分温顺，而且……口感极佳。在这些庞大的培养场中，这些生物经过喂养后将会被收割，成为食物。

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adecision_arcology_project_effects&lang=en)

### 中文

—将星球变成§Y$pc_city$§!，增加£housing£§Y$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$§!，§Y资源生产§!和§Y人口增长§!并解锁特殊的£district£§Y理想城区划§!。\n—§R无法发展§!£district£§Y发电§!、§Y采矿§!和§Y农业区划§!。\n—在该过程中所有的£district£§Y区划§!建设将被§R禁用§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2754`

### English

- Turns the planet into an §Y$pc_city$§!, increasing £housing£ §Y$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$§!, §YResource Production§! and §YPop Growth§! and unlocking special £district£ §YArcology Districts§!.\n- £district£ §YGenerator§!, §YMining§! and §YAgriculture Districts§! become §Rinaccessible§!.\n- Construction of any £district£ §YDistricts§! while this is underway are §RDisabled§!.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:2983`

## decision_arcology_project_effects_short

## decision_slave_colony_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adecision_slave_colony_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个星球是为了从被奴役的人口中挖掘出最大的潜力而建造的。奴隶离开这个行星的主要途径是通过专门的军事中心，把他们锻造成忠诚的仆从军，为无情的战争做好准备。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2815`

### English

This world is purpose-built to extract the maximum potential from an enslaved population. The main way off the planet for slaves is through specialized military centers that forge them into loyal battle thrall armies, conditioned for relentless warfare.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3056`

### English

- Replaces £district£ §YCity Districts§! with §Y$district_slave_plural$§!\n- Replaces £district£ §Y$district_industrial_plural$§! with §Y$district_battle_thrall$§!\n$job_battle_thrall_effect_desc$\n- Disables most £building£ §YBuildings§! on the planet\n- £pop£ §HFree Pops§! can no longer grow on the planet\n\n

## decision_penal_colony_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adecision_penal_colony_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

将这整颗星球作为一座巨大的惩戒殖民地。庞大的监狱社群基本上由囚犯们自治，而惩罚通常意味着被流放到严酷的荒野中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:2823`

### English

This entire world is set aside as a massive penal colony. The vast prison communities are largely self-managed by the prisoners, and punishment often means exile into the unforgiving wilderness.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3065`

## mega.200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

层层叠加的都市终于完全覆盖了星球的地表。\n\n自从这一宏大计划开始实施以来仅仅过了数年，但已经很难回想起[Root.GetName]从前的面貌。翠绿的丛林？崎岖的山脉？现在放眼望去，四面八方都是延绵不绝的钢铁。\n\n这里曾经由自然法则任意塑造，而现在则成了由坚定的目的锤炼而成的设计。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3092`

### English

Layers upon layers of urban sprawl eclipse the globe's crust, and it is done.\n\nScant few years have passed since the start of this grand project, but it is already difficult to recall what the surface of [Root.GetName] was like. Verdant? Rugged? It is all steel now, miles in every direction.\n\nA place once molded by chance and the unthinking laws of nature, now a design wrought from indomitable purpose.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3349`

### English

## crime.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!的失业与贫困率正在以令人诧异的速度攀升着。然而，这一不幸的事况正在被当地的犯罪组织所利用。他们打劫走投无路的平民，也招收穷困潦倒的新人入伙。\n\n作为临时的处理方案，我们可以提升[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的失业补助金。虽然可能会花费大量预算，但可以为我们争取宝贵的时间以制定永久的解决方案，例如创造更多工作岗位，提升失业与贫困民众的生活标准等。\n\n当然我们也可以袖手旁观，但这很可能会造成[Root.GetName]上形成庞大的地下犯罪组织。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3182`

### English

Unemployment and poverty are spreading at an alarming rate on §H[Root.GetName]§!. This sorry state of affairs is being exploited by local crime organizations, who find themselves awash with both easy marks and desperate recruits.\n\nAs a temporary solution, we could increase the unemployment benefits on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It will not be cheap, but would provide additional time to seek a more permanent solution, such as creating more jobs or improving the living standards of the affected population groups.\n\nWe could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the formation of a significant criminal underworld on [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3440`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.1.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们的拾荒子个体在§H[Root.GetName]§!上漫无目的地在泥土中搜刮，越来越多的拾荒者开始背离蜂巢并自主思考。它们组织起了自己的秘密社群，并开始从蜂巢中窃取资源。\n\n我们可以采取临时措施，让这些拾荒子个体参与某些活动计划，使其忙碌到无暇背离蜂巢思维的意志。这需要花一些代价，但可以让我们有更多时间创造额外的岗位。\n\n我们也可以放任不管，但这很可能会导致[Root.GetName]上出现大量反常子个体的聚落。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3184`

### English

As our drones on §H[Root.GetName]§! aimlessly scrabble in the dirt, an increasing number have turned to deviancy and independent thought. They have formed their own, hidden communities, and now spend their time pilfering resources from the rest of the hive.\n\nTo prevent this, a temporary solution could be to engage the drones in some sort of activity program that keeps them too busy to stray from the will of the Hive Mind. It will not be cheap, but this would give us additional time to create more jobs.\n\nWe could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the formation of significant deviant drone communities on [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3442`

## crime.1.b.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.1.b.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

这样的反常度可以给我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]带来丰富的实验机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3185`

### English

Deviancy of this nature will provide our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with ample opportunity for new experimentation.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3443`

## crime.1.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.1.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!上的闲置无人机的数量与日俱增，很多无业无人机也开始将闲置的运算力用于背离集体意识和未授权的功能。这种腐化现象正迅速传播，受影响的单位开始组建脱离核心智能控制的个人网络。\n\n为了避免这种现象，我们的短期方案是命令所有无业无人机进入待机模式并将他们直连到核心智能中。此举会大幅增加维护费，但却可以为我们争取更多的时间去创造就业岗位。\n\n我们也可以选择袖手旁观，但是这么做会导致[Root.GetName]出现持续增长的腐化无人机网络。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3186`

### English

The number of idle drones on §H[Root.GetName]§! continues to increase, and many of these unemployed units have begun diverting their processing power towards deviant and unauthorized functions. This corruption is spreading rapidly, and the affected units are starting to form their own networks beyond the control of the core intelligence.\n\nTo prevent this, a temporary solution could be to put all unemployed drones into standby mode and connect them directly into the core intelligence. This will drastically increase their maintenance costs, but it would give us time to create more jobs.\n\nWe could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the continued proliferation of corrupted drone networks on [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3444`

## crime.2.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.2.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]的受贿官员

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3198`

### English

Bribed Officials on [Root.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3456`

## crime.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最近收集到的证据表明，§H[Root.GetName]§!政府的一大部分成员都有接收贿赂。当地的犯罪组织通过贿赂他们来保证对其犯罪活动视而不见。某些官员甚至被披露隶属于他们本该与之进行抗争的犯罪组织！\n\n虽然我们逮捕了一部分官员，但也有不少人发现情势不对，就直接收拾细软逃走了。看来想要解决[Root.GetName]的受贿问题仍然困难重重。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3199`

### English

Recently obtained evidence has revealed that a large number of government officials on §H[Root.GetName]§! were on the take. Local crime organizations bribed them to look the other way while they engaged in their nefarious activities. In some cases, the officials were exposed as members of the very organizations they were supposed to fight!\n\nSeveral arrests have been made, but many of the officials abandoned their posts when they realized the jig was up. The corruption on [Root.GetName] seems to run deep.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3457`

## crime.3.desc

### 中文

随着§H[Root.GetName]§!的犯罪率大幅提升，当地人口的毒品使用率也在逐步提升。各种各样的非法药物不仅仅只出现在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的地下犯罪组织中，并影响着所有人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3203`

### English

Following in the wake of the rising crime on §H[Root.GetName]§!, drug abuse among the population has increased significantly in recent times. The use of illegal narcotics has spread well beyond the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s criminal underworld, and now affects all walks of life.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3461`

## crime.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!的两大地下帮派一直以来都在进行大大小小武装争斗，但最近的情况更加糟糕。在都市中心爆发了数次街头枪战，星球当局也难以控制局势。受到牵连的无辜百姓数目众多。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3208`

### English

Violent clashes between the armed gangs that run the criminal underworld on §H[Root.GetName]§! have recently escalated. Street fighting has erupted in several urban centers, with the planetary authorities struggling to contain it. Collateral damage has been heavy.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3466`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.4.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3209`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3467`

### 中文

[Root.GetName]发现走私犯罪行为

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3212`

### English

Smuggler Activity Reported on [Root.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3470`

## crime.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

众所周知，§H[Root.GetName]§!的走私犯罪情况愈发严重。据了解，在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的表面发现了一些“灰色港口”——也就是没有经过政府批准的太空港，经常是各种走私犯与其他罪犯的聚集地。\n\n星球当局正在想尽办法将这些港口一网打尽，但直到这一问题被彻底解决前，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]正规渠道的贸易将会受到损失。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3213`

### English

There has been a marked increase in smuggler activity on §H[Root.GetName]§! recently. A number of \"Gray Ports\" - unauthorized spaceports where smugglers and other criminal elements convene - are believed to exist on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.\n\nThe local authorities are working on tracking down these illegal ports, but until they succeed trade on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] will suffer.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3471`

## crime.5.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.5.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3214`

### English

Although a nuisance, such a nexus of illicit activity will provide our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with an abundance of genetic diversity to study.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3472`

## crime.6.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.6.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!的犯罪率近期有大幅度的提升，而[Root.GetPlanetMoon]也几乎要变成不法之地了。最近的犯罪目标基本上都是住宅区域，此前我们都认为住宅区位于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]当地最大犯罪团伙的活动范围之外。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3218`

### English

There has been a recent upswing in crime on §H[Root.GetName]§!, as the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] continues its descent into lawlessness. This latest crime wave has targeted residential areas that up until now had been considered outside of the influence of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s dominant criminal gangs.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3476`

## crime.7.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.7.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在接到匿名线人的线索后，§H[Root.GetName]§!警方全力出动，围剿了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]首都外围的大型仓库。警方在仓库内发现了大量违禁走私物品，据调查后发现其属于当地的犯罪组织。在将部分组织成员逮捕后，警方没收了所有违禁走私物品，并将其储存在政府库存之中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3223`

### English

Following up on an anonymous tip, Enforcers on §H[Root.GetName]§! recently stormed a large warehouse on the outskirts of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s capital. Inside they found a considerable stash of contraband, evidently stored here by a local criminal organization. Several arrests have been made, and the impounded contraband is now safely stored in government depots.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3481`

我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们迫不及待地想把这批非法物质编入目录，并期望在进一步的实验中得到巨大的发现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3224`

### English

Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to catalogue this trove of illicit substances, and anticipate great discoveries from their applied use in further experiments.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3482`

## crime.8.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.8.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一次执法者突击行动中，§H[Root.GetName]§!的首要犯罪头目终于落网。随着其头目的消失，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]大型犯罪团伙减少了犯罪活动，当地的犯罪率也因此下降。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3228`

### English

An important crime boss on §H[Root.GetName]§! was recently caught in an Enforcer sting operation. The loss of their leader has severely curtailed the activities of one of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s major criminal organizations, leading to a marked decrease in crime.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3486`

## crime.8.desc.experimenters

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3229`

### English

Such an acquisition gives us a unique opportunity for the study of a highly regarded criminal mind. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to begin intrusive analysis.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3487`

## crime.40.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.40.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!的犯罪问题仍然没有得到解决，而现在各种犯罪组织已经在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]扎根落脚。许多地区不是堕落为法外之地，就是彻底沦陷在犯罪组织的掌控之中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3233`

### English

Crime continues to be a problem on §H[Root.GetName]§!, and an extensive criminal underworld has now taken root on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Some areas have descended into lawlessness or been taken over completely by criminal organizations.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3491`

## crime.40.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.40.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

幸运的是，这种环境能给我们源源不断地提供新鲜的实验对象。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫不及待地想探索新的研究道路了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3234`

### English

Fortunately, such environments provide us with an ample supply of fresh test subjects. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to explore new avenues of research.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3492`

## crime.40.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.40.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!上的叛乱事件持续蔓延，并出现了对蜂巢意志的公开挑衅。情报显示[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上已经出现了成社区的子个体叛乱，并开始窃取其余子个体的资源来维持他们的叛乱活动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3235`

### English

Deviant activity continues to grow on §H[Root.GetName]§!, in open defiance of the will of the Hive Mind. Entire communities of deviant drones are believed to exist on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] now, stealing resources from the rest of the hive to support their nefarious activities.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3493`

## crime.40.b.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.40.b.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

这些反常子个体会作为实验对象得到重新利用。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]或许会在后续的解剖中发现它们腐化的原因。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3236`

### English

Such deviants will find new purpose as test subjects. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] will perhaps find the root of their corruption during subsequent dissections.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3494`

## crime.40.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.40.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!上的腐化度进一步恶化了。反常分子开始公开行动，为所欲为，挑战着核心智能的权威。情报显示对方应该已组成了自主的网络以互相交换信息和能源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3237`

### English

The corruption grows deeper on §H[Root.GetName]§!. Deviant units now operate in the open according to their own parameters, spurning the commands of the core intelligence. They are believed to have formed their own networks where they exchange information and stolen energy.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3495`

## crime.41.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.41.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着§H[Root.GetName]§!上的犯罪率大幅降低，曾经横行[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的犯罪集团也都被一一瓦解了。当地人民终于迎来了久违的安宁和谐的生活。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3244`

### English

With the significant reduction of crime on §H[Root.GetName]§!, the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s once pervasive criminal underworld has been reduced to nothingness. The population has been imbued with a renewed sense of safety and harmony.

## crime.41.b.desc.experimenters

### English

§H[Root.GetName]§!上的所有腐化无人机已被彻底净化干净。所有无人机单位都在核心智能的指令下正常的运作。

## crime.100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!上处于龙头的两个犯罪组织几个月来一直处于兵刃相见、势不两立的局面，而现在全面战争终于爆发了。[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的大街小巷中都是刀光剑影，而许多住宅区域也未能幸免。\n\n当地安保部队正在尽全力遏制暴力事件的发生，但由于犯罪组织人数众多，尚未能见成效。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3252`

### English

A bitter feud has been brewing for months between the two largest criminal organizations on §H[Root.GetName]§!, and it has now finally come to a head. Vicious fighting has erupted in streets and alleys across the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], and it is rapidly spreading into residential areas.\n\nOur local security forces are doing what they can to contain the violence, but the sheer scale of the fighting has left them overwhelmed.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3510`

## crime.100.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.100.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

这样的环境给我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们留下了大量的实验材料。他们说，福祸相依嘛。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3253`

### English

Such an environment has left our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with a backlog of experimentation material. Every cloud, as they say.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3511`

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的帮派伏击！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3255`

### English

Gang Ambush on [Root.GetName]!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3513`

## crime.101.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.101.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!的犯罪组织之一最近对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的执法人员进行了一系列伏击。在同一时间内，帮派成员伏击了各地的巡逻警官，有多个警区已经完全落入犯罪组织的手中。此次大型作案造成数千人死亡。\n\n剩余的执法人员团队由于人手严重不足以难以维持局面。目前[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的许多区域已经完全沦陷，情况十分危急。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3256`

### English

One of the gangs on §H[Root.GetName]§! recently launched a concerted attack on law enforcement officers all over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. At a given hour, gang members ambushed patrolling Enforcers while several precincts were completely overrun. The intense fighting has left thousands dead.\n\nOur remaining security forces are struggling to regain control, but for the time being many regions of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have descended into utter lawlessness.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3514`

## crime.101.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.101.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### English

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3515`

## crime.102.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.102.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!上黑帮火并引发的动乱已经扩散到[Root.solar_system.GetName]星系的其余部分。据报道，两伙人已用武装民船战了几场。双方都在打劫贸易船以获得资金及扩大舰队。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3262`

### English

The violent gang war that has been raging on §H[Root.GetName]§! has spread to the rest of the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system. There have been reports of several clashes between armed civilian ships flying gang colors, and both sides of the war are going after incoming trade vessels with the goal of securing more income and expanding their fleets.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3520`

## crime.102.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.102.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]申请观察报复的后果以及大量尸体抛入真空的大规模实例。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3263`

### English

Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] have requested that they be allowed to observe the aftermath of our retaliation and the large-scale instance of corpses mass-ejected into the vacuum of space.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3521`

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的帮派激战

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3267`

### English

Pitched Gang Battle on [Root.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3525`

## crime.103.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.103.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!的两个主要黑社会帮派最近在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]最大的城市中心进行了十分血腥的战斗。双方死亡人数已有数万人，但最终仍没有分出输赢。\n\n这场残酷的战斗几乎将整个城市都夷为平地，城市中的大部分居民都被迫逃走了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3268`

### English

A pitched battle between the two major gangs of §H[Root.GetName]§! was recently waged in one of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s largest urban centers. The body count is in the tens of thousands on both sides, and there was no clear winner.\n\nThe savage fighting razed the city nearly to the ground, and most of its population were forced to flee.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3526`

## crime.103.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.103.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

这种无端的暴力也不是毫无魅力可言。也许还能从死者身上抢救出新的科学研究成果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3269`

### English

Such senseless violence is not without its charms. We may yet be able to salvage new scientific research from the deceased.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3527`

## crime.104.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.104.name&lang=en)

### 中文

帮派战争对商业活动造成影响

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3273`

### English

Traders Steer Clear Of Gang Wars

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3531`

## crime.104.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.104.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!的帮派战争仍然持续不断，并且对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的商业贸易产生了十分负面的影响。鉴于当前的状况，不少星际贸易公会都颁布了对此行星的旅行警告，建议商人们不要前往[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。不过与其同时，走私军火的生意倒是火得不行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3274`

### English

The ongoing struggle between the gangs on §H[Root.GetName]§! has had a negative impact on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s trade. With the volatile situation on the surface, several interstellar merchant guilds have issued a travel advisory warning traders to stay away from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The trafficking of illegal arms seems to be booming, however.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3532`

## crime.104.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.104.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]将这些强力的武器带到大街小巷上，迫不及待想测试它们对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]身体的破坏力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3275`

### English

With such powerful weaponry making its way onto the streets, our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to examine their damaging effects on the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] body.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3533`

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的毒品交易扩大

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3278`

### English

Drug Trade Expands on [Root.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3536`

## crime.200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着§H[Root.GetName]§!犯罪活动的日益猖獗，非法药品的买卖数量也达到了历史新高。全宇宙最有名的各种毒品在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]都能找得到。\n\n对于这里的人民来说，使用毒品已经成为稀松平常的事情了。这对于生产力来说无疑是个灾难。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3279`

### English

With crime running rampant on §H[Root.GetName]§!, the sale of illegal narcotics has also increased to new record levels. A wide variety of addictive drugs from all over known space is now being smuggled onto the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].\n\nDrug use has become widespread among the population, to the detriment of general productivity.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3537`

## crime.200.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.200.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

这种新兴的犯罪活动应该会为我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]带来令人兴奋的新研究途径。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3280`

### English

This emerging criminal activity should lend our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] an exciting new avenue of study.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3538`

## crime.201.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.201.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的新型毒品

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3283`

### English

New Drug Introduced on [Root.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3541`

## crime.201.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.201.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!的走私犯们带来了一种全新的毒品，似乎来自于文明世界之外的太空海盗领域。这种毒品不仅极易成瘾，而且对绝大多数生命形态而言，用量稍微过高就能够致命。\n\n虽然当地政府正在竭尽全力阻止这种致命毒品继续传播，但[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的死亡率却一直在攀升。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3284`

### English

Smugglers on §H[Root.GetName]§! have introduced a new drug that we believe originated from somewhere in the pirate territories beyond civilized space. This drug is not only highly addictive, but it has also proven quite lethal to most life forms if consumed in anything but small quantities.\n\nWhile local authorities are doing what they can to stem the spread of this drug, there has been a rash of deaths all over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3542`

## crime.201.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.201.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

无论如何，我们已经通过研究这些物质及其对实验对象的影响获得了一些令人惊叹的研究进展。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3285`

### English

In any case, we have observed some fascinating developments in our research through the study of this substance and its effects on test subjects.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3543`

## crime.202.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.202.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的毒贩寡头冲突

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3289`

### English

Drug Cartels Clash on [Root.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3547`

## crime.202.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.202.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在§H[Root.GetName]§!做生意的各大犯罪寡头们在毒品市场中一直处于激烈的竞争，但最近其竞争终于擦出了火花。据报告，贩毒团伙的成员们使用军用武器进行了数次冲突，造成了大量财产损失，且有众多无辜平民伤亡。看来走私进[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的不只有毒品而已。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3290`

### English

Competition for markets is fierce between the criminal cartels that are involved in the drug trade on §H[Root.GetName]§!. There have been several recent clashes involving heavy military-grade infantry weapons that caused considerable property damage and left untold civilians dead. It would seem drugs aren't the only thing being smuggled onto the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3548`

### English

[GetExperimentersEmergingCrime]

## crime.203.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.203.name&lang=en)

### 中文

毒品运输船在[Root.GetName]坠毁

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3292`

### English

Drug Freighter Crashes on [Root.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3550`

## crime.203.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.203.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一艘大型民用运输舰船在申请进入§H[Root.GetName]§!大气层停靠后，其申请因在货舱查出非法毒品而被拒绝。当地政府想要对舰船进行进一步搜索时，舰船的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]舰长因为吸食毒品过量，企图冲击轨道防线，强行进行着陆。\n\n运输船在下降时被我方行星保安部队击中，导致其坠毁在人口十分密集的城市地区。事发现场几乎没有任何的幸存者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3293`

### English

A large civilian freighter was recently denied atmospheric entry on §H[Root.GetName]§! after it was found to be carrying illegal drugs in an auxiliary cargo compartment. As the freighter was ordered to heave to for inspection, its captain, a drug-crazed [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], instead opted to burn past the orbital blockade in an attempt to land.\n\nThe freighter was hit by ground fire from our planetside security forces as it descended, causing it to crash into a densely populated city district. There were few survivors on the ground.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3551`

## crime.203.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.203.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫不及待地想研究那些散布到周围社区环境中的毒品的影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3294`

### English

Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to study the effects of the narcotics that have since dissipated into the environment in the surrounding communities.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3552`

## crime.204.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.204.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的毒品交易仍在继续

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3297`

### English

Drug Trade Continues on [Root.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3555`

## crime.204.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.204.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!的非法毒品交易仍然十分猖獗。最近我们接到报告，说走私犯们想尽办法，侵入了我方轨道中的异星天然气仓库，并窃取了数种具有致幻效果的气体。这些气体随即便被药贩子们在[Root.GetName]的阴暗小巷中贩卖。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3298`

### English

The illicit drug trade continues unabated on §H[Root.GetName]§!. We recently discovered that smugglers have somehow pilfered Exotic Gases from one of our orbital storage yards, singling out those gases with known psychedelic properties. They were then distributed to dealers and sold in the back alleys of [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3556`

## crime.204.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.204.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]惊讶于他们一开始竟然没想到异星天然气的这些妙用。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3299`

### English

Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are surprised they didn't think of these clever applications of Exotic Gases first.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3557`

## crime.204.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.204.a&lang=en)

不能这么下去了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3300`

### English

This can't be allowed to continue!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3558`

## crime.204.a.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.204.a.experimenters&lang=en)

## crime.300.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.300.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!上最大的犯罪组织日前终于消灭了其在行星上的所有竞争对手，成为了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]庞大犯罪集团的唯一领袖。一直以来他们都在暗中破坏行星政府的权威，而当地人也早已经把他们当成了[Root.GetName]的真正统治者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3303`

### English

The dominant crime syndicate on §H[Root.GetName]§! recently eliminated the last of its competitors and achieved complete control over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s extensive criminal underworld. They have long since undermined the real planetary authorities, and the local population now look upon these gangsters as the true rulers of [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3561`

[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们认定这颗行星对未来研究而言具有“资产丰富”的环境。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3304`

### English

Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] have designated this planet an \"asset rich\" environment for future research.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3562`

## crime.301.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.301.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

控制§H[Root.GetName]§!区域的犯罪组织规划了十分庞大的保护费收取网。由于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]政府与执法系统对于有组织的犯罪行为束手无策，人民也只能屈服于该犯罪组织，以保自身平安。这也导致了该区域的生产力也连连下降。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3307`

### English

The gangsters controlling §H[Root.GetName]§! have instituted an extensive protection racket. Since the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s true judicial and law enforcement systems have proved unable to deal with organized crime, the population feels that it has no choice but to submit to the authority of these criminals. This has had a serious effect on productivity.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3565`

## crime.301.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.301.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

从积极的角度看，这些帮派似乎在给[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们提供实验对象的方面比更正规一些的渠道都还有效。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3308`

### English

On a positive note, these gangsters tend to be more efficient at providing our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with test subjects than more official channels.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3566`

### English

## crime.302.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.302.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对§H[Root.GetName]§!最近实地调查显示，该行星政府的大部分成员都受雇于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]最大的犯罪组织。虽然涉事官员已经全部被调换，但这也打破了该区域的一向秩序。\n\n此外，[Root.GetName]的地下统治者现在也在加紧收买刚上任的新官员们……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3312`

### English

A recent fact-finding mission to §H[Root.GetName]§! revealed that the vast majority of the planetary administration was in the employ of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s dominant crime syndicate. The corrupt officials in question have all been replaced, but this has led to significant disruptions in the public sector.\n\nIn addition, the gangsters that rule the criminal underworld of [Root.GetName] are even now trying to bribe or coerce the new officials into their organization.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3570`

## crime.303.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.303.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

进行暗杀的成员来自§H[Root.GetName]§!最有权势的犯罪组织，而他们暗杀的正是[governor_target.GetTitle][governor_target.GetName]！在[governor_target.GetTitle]的车队离开太空港时，被犯罪组织所拦截。护卫队伍与暗杀成员们进行了激烈的交火。\n\n当战斗结束后，我们获得消息确认[governor_target.GetTitle]因公殉职了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3318`

### English

Gangsters from the criminal syndicate that dominates the underworld on §H[Root.GetName]§! have assassinated [governor_target.GetTitle] [governor_target.GetName]! The [governor_target.GetTitle]'s motorcade was cut off as it left the spaceport, and an intense firefight flared up between the escorting security detachment and the attacking gangsters.\n\nWhen the dust settled, the [governor_target.GetTitle] was confirmed to have been among the dead.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3576`

## crime.304.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.304.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在§H[Root.GetName]§!称霸的犯罪组织目前控制了大部分进出[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的交易。他们完全掌控了几大太空港对所有进出的货物雁过拔毛。因此，[Root.GetName]的贸易利润急剧下降。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3322`

### English

The crime syndicate running §H[Root.GetName]§! now controls a significant portion of the trade to and from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. They have established total control over several major spaceports, where all trade must go through their intermediaries. As a result, our trade incomes from [Root.GetName] are down across the board.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3580`

## crime.501.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.501.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!上出现的反常子个体的数量日益壮大，开始对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生产效率造成了明显的影响。这些反常分子不断地干扰我们的子个体的工作，偷走必要的工具及设备。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3331`

### English

The presence of an increasing number of deviant drones on §H[Root.GetName]§! has begun to have a detrimental effect on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s production efficiency. As our drones go about their business, the deviants frequently get in the way or steal needed tools and equipment.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3589`

### English

Deviant Ringleader Terminated on [Root.GetName]

## crime.502.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.502.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

反常分子中极具影响力的某个子个体最近一直活跃于§H[Root.GetName]§!上进行骚乱活动，最终成功被正常子个体干掉。此子个体的死亡严重影响了其他反常子个体的行动，这意味着该子个体是个重要的首脑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3336`

### English

One of the more influential drones among the deviants that have been agitating and causing trouble on §H[Root.GetName]§! was recently cornered and killed by loyalist drones. The death of this drone appears to have severely curtailed the activities of the other deviants, indicating its role as an important ringleader.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3594`

## crime.502.desc.experimenters

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.502.desc.experimenters&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]注意到了对这个颇具影响力的异常子个体的解剖价值。期望能从这具了无生气的躯壳中学到很多东西。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3337`

### English

The value in dissecting this influential deviant has been noted by our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]. We expect to learn much from their lifeless vessel.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3595`

## crime.550.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.550.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!上的某个大型腐化无人机网络最近将所有[Root.Owner.GetName]认定为敌对单位。这些无人机发动袭击对我们造成了极大的破坏，最后才成功被我们的安保单位彻底击退。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3341`

### English

One of the larger networks of corrupted drone units on §H[Root.GetName]§! recently designated the entirety of the [Root.Owner.GetName] as hostile. These drones went on a rampage and caused considerable damage before our loyal security units succeeded in either destroying or driving them off.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3599`

## crime.551.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrime.551.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!上的腐化无人机网络开始干扰正常单位的工作了。对方所散播的信号几乎完全掩盖了核心智能的指令，导致我们的工作无人机行动卡顿，错误操作时常出现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3344`

### English

The corrupted drone networks on §H[Root.GetName]§! have started to interfere with the operation of our functional units. Their signals are drowning out those of the core intelligence, resulting in sluggish and sometimes erratic behavior on the part of our worker drones.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3602`

A large number of arrests have been made, forcing their criminal branch office out of business.

## distar.330.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adistar.330.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

过去的42年零3天里，位于[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员一直怀着热烈的期望观察着我们在[From.From.From.GetName]发现的原子钟进行的倒计时。\n\n现在几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散，同样消失的还有[nuked_primitive_planet.GetName]的大部分。\n\n随着原子钟倒数归零，他向[nuked_primitive_planet.GetName]上的某个接收器发射了一个信号，触发了一场灾难性的热核爆炸，摧毁了整个行星和定居于此的原始文明。\n\n在我们的科学家还在为这次精准定时的毁灭行为背后的缘由争论不休的时候，这台原子钟依旧在滴答作响，仿佛下方的荒凉死寂和它毫无关系一样。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3357`

### English

For the past 42 years and 3 days, researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision, found on [From.From.From.GetName].\n\nNow several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant, along with most of [nuked_primitive_planet.GetName].\n\nAs the clock reached its momentous deadline it transmitted a signal to a receiver on [nuked_primitive_planet.GetName], triggering a thermonuclear explosion of such devastating power it laid waste to the entire planet and the primitive society residing there.\n\nWhile our scientists debate the reason behind this carefully timed act of annihilation, the atomic clock continues to tick, undisturbed by the desolation below.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3616`

## mega.1000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.1000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

伴随着吱呀声，$matter_decompressor_1$细长如虚幻般的横臂开始缓缓运转。\n\n看起来摇摇欲坠的空间站的晃动渐渐停止，而阵阵能量与微粒物质从[From.GetName]事件视界的阴影中射出。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3638`

### English

The spindly, ethereal leg-beams of the $matter_decompressor_1$ sputter to life.\n\nThe spasms and paroxysms of the precarious station eventually give way to an even thrum of flowing energy and particulate matter, swept up from the umbra beyond [From.GetName]'s event horizon.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3908`

## mega.1100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.1100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$strategic_coordination_center_1$雄伟地屹立着。\n\n军方工程师们发现根本就不可能对这种大小的空间站进行伪装，于是便没有在这方面花费任何时间，使它一目了然：这里武装了最尖端通信工具、传感器列阵，以及一支技术高超的战略及后勤专家团。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3641`

### English

The $strategic_coordination_center_1$ cuts an imposing figure as it glides into view of the obs-cams.\n\nOur military engineers realized that they had no hope of disguising the true purpose of a station of this size, so it looks exactly like what it is: a box filled with cutting-edge comms equipment, sensor arrays, and a highly-skilled tactical logistics team.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3912`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3642`

### English

The §H$strategic_coordination_center_1$§! improves §Y$MOD_COUNTRY_NAVAL_CAP_ADD$§!, §Y$mod_shipclass_starbase_damage_mult$§!, §Y$MOD_STARBASE_DEFENSE_PLATFORM_CAPACITY_ADD$§!, §Y$mod_shipsize_corvette_build_speed_mult$§!, §Y$mod_shipsize_destroyer_build_speed_mult$§!, §Y$mod_shipsize_cruiser_build_speed_mult$§!, and §Y$mod_shipsize_battleship_build_speed_mult$§!.

## cara_home_about_fleet1.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara_home_about_fleet1.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

所有相关的行商舰队维持着亚空间通讯发明之前的传统。而我们$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$是个例外，所以所有呼叫都转移到了我们这边。\n\n恐怕你得等[From.GetName]再次进入你们领地之后主动呼叫你。或者是在离开你们领地的时候，具体取决于你们之间的约定。\n\n在你等待的时候，何不试试$slots$呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3683`

### English

All affiliated caravan fleets uphold traditions predating the invention of subspace communications. We, here at $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$, are the exception, thus all calls are rerouted to us.\n\nI'm afraid you'll have to wait for [From.GetName] to contact you when they enter your territory once again. Or depart it, depending on what you have agreed on.\n\nWhy not try your luck at the $slots$ while you wait?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:3962`
