## lootboxdesc1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootboxdesc1&lang=en)

### 中文

§E年代久远的$lootbox$被放置在豪华的十字基座上。宝箱里一定存满了各种宝物。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3747`

### English

§EThe ancient $lootbox$ rests on an opulent pedestal. It must surely be filled with untold riches.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4038`

## cara_home_lootbox_explain

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara_home_lootbox_explain&lang=en)

### 中文

什么是$lootboxes$？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3748`

### English

What are $lootboxes$?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4039`

## cara_home_lootbox_explain.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara_home_lootbox_explain.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一个很古老的故事了，但并不冗长。\n\n最早一批行商聚在一起并且确立了[caravaneer_home_country.GetName]之后，每年经过这个贸易站的一小部分货物都会被封存起来，放入一个密封的容器里面，然后放在贸易站最底层的货舱中。这项传统从很久以前就一直流传到了现在，现在货舱被填满了。\n\n那我们也该是时候出售这些$lootboxes$了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3749`

### English

It is an old story, but not a long one.\n\nWhen the caravans first came together and the [caravaneer_home_country.GetName] was established, it was decreed that a small, random portion of goods passing through this station every year was to be seized, placed in hermetically sealed containers, and stored in a cargo bay on the lowest level of the station. This custom has been upheld since time immemorial, and the cargo bay recently filled up.\n\nIt is now our duty to sell these sealed $lootboxes$.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4040`

## cara_home_lootbox_contents

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara_home_lootbox_contents&lang=en)

### 中文

$lootbox$里面有什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3750`

### English

What's inside a $lootbox$?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4041`

## cara_home_lootbox_contents.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara_home_lootbox_contents.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

这个我们无法得知，只有买了的人才能知晓。\n\n我们知道的是，这里面的东西曾经某个时候肯定有某种价值。虽然有证据表明$lootbox$里面的东西有可能是疯狂掮客故意放进去用过的垃圾……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3751`

### English

We are prohibited from knowing. That knowledge is for the buyer.\n\nWhat we do know is that the contents were considered valuable at some point in Caravaneer history. Though there is also some evidence that the $lootbox$ containers may have been used for garbage disposal during the brief third reign of the Lunatic Broker...

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4042`

## openedlootboxdesc1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aopenedlootboxdesc1&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$lootbox$是……§R空的§!。\n\n你尽可能压抑心中的怨念不让心中的羞恼之意浮于面部。到底是因为湿度骤增还是因为你的眼睛不受控制的湿润了？你的目光模糊了，但是空无一物的$lootbox$依旧在那安然不动。\n\n但随着一阵存在主义的黑暗吞噬过后，一切都过去了。这是什么感觉？回想起在你花费掉辛苦挣来的$ccoinz$，缓缓打开$lootbox$时那种发自内心的紧张与激动……你现在充满了一种说不清道不明的§G骄傲与成就感§!。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3752`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ is... §Rempty§!.\n\nBitter disappointment claws at your insides as you struggle to maintain your composure in the face of this chance humiliation. Did humidity levels suddenly rise or are your ocular organs moistening on their own? Your vision blurs, but the emptiness of the $lootbox$ still stands out in sharp relief.\n\nBut as soon as an existential darkness threatens to devour you, it is swept away. What is this feeling? As you mull over the hard-earned $ccoinz$ you spent, the visceral thrill of opening the $lootbox$... you are filled with an inexplicable §Gsense of pride and accomplishment§!.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4044`

## buying_boxes_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuying_boxes_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

好的，懂。我们明白了。你喜欢抽遗物箱！通常来说，我们会限制卖给单个客户的遗物箱数量，但是我们能够给你开个例外。从现在开始，尽享直接购买遗物箱的特权吧，只是每次所花费的§Y能量币§!会略有提升。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3757`

### English

Okay, look. We get it. You love Reliquaries! While we generally limit the amount sold to a single customer, we can make an exception for you. From now on, enjoy the privilege of purchasing Reliquaries directly, with only a nominal increase in §YEnergy Credits§! each time.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4049`

## lootbox_contents_a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_a&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$lootbox$包含着一副远古图表，写满了早已失传的贸易路线，其中还包括了我们的首都恒星系§Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!§!！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3767`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4061`

## lootbox_contents_b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_b&lang=en)

### 中文

§E $lootbox$里存放着一整套的制服。可惜的是，这些衣服的设计对象是某种比[Root.GetName]的物种更多肢体的生物。\n\n不过，这些衣服的质料还是可以循环利用的。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3768`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ contains a full complement of dress uniforms. Unfortunately they were designed for a species with far more limbs than is common within the [Root.GetName].\n\nThe material might still be re-purposed, however.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4062`

## lootbox_contents_c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_c&lang=en)

§E$lootbox$里有炸弹！\n\n别担心，已经拆掉了。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3769`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ contains a bomb!\n\nIt is swiftly defused.§!

## lootbox_contents_f

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_f&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$lootbox$装着满满的军粮。虽然上面的所有标记都已经磨损殆尽了，但是里面的东西看起来尚且安全，而且适合[Root.GetAdj]的生理结构。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3774`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ contains a shipment of military rations. All markings on the packaging have worn off, but the contents appear safe and compatible with [Root.GetAdj] biology.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4068`

## lootbox_contents_g

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_g&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$lootbox$里面放着音乐，虽然这盒子里并没有任何显而易见的类似播放器的东西。\n\n$lootbox$马上被关上，并且被遗忘在某个角落里面§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3775`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ contains music, without any obvious playback mechanism.\n\nThe $lootbox$ is soon closed and forgotten about.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4069`

## lootbox_contents_g.tooltip

## lootbox_contents_h

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_h&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$lootbox$装满了美丽的蓝色大理石。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3777`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ is filled with beautiful blue marbles.§!

## lootbox_contents_i

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_i&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$lootbox$里面装着数不清的财富，如果你对不在场的人说起的话，没有人会相信这么巨量的财富会真实存在。\n\n不过财务报表上的赤字正宣告着这个事实。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3778`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ is filled with untold riches. Indeed, no one present at the opening is capable of accurately describing the immense wealth, if they will even acknowledge its existence at all.\n\nBut the treasury's balance sheet spells it out clearly enough.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4072`

## lootbox_contents_j

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_j&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$lootbox$里面装着几个外星设备，看上去没什么反应，应该是坏了的。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3779`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ holds a handful of alien devices, inert and seemingly broken.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4073`

## lootbox_contents_k

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_k&lang=en)

### 中文

§E虽然是空的，但是这个$lootbox$的内壁上到底都是各种印记。在更深处的地方追踪到了一些生物物质的踪迹。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3780`

### English

§EWhile empty, the inner walls of the $lootbox$ are pitted and scarred. Traces of biological material can be recovered from the deeper pockets.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4074`

## lootbox_contents_l

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_l&lang=en)

### 中文

§E $lootbox$里存放着一个只能以波频的方式存在于空灵界面的生灵。它在被发现后瞬间逃离到更高阶的位面，只在你心里留下深刻的启示与不安。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3781`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ holds a being that exists only as a spectrum of wavelengths in an ethereal medium. It immediately escapes to a higher domain, leaving only profound revelation and paralytic fear in its wake.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4075`

## lootbox_contents_m

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_m&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$lootbox$很难打开，感觉里面似乎是有一个小型的重力井阻止它打开似的。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3782`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ is difficult to open, as it is shut tight from within by a gravitational anomaly.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4076`

## lootbox_contents_n

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alootbox_contents_n&lang=en)

### 中文

§E$lootbox$里面什么都没有。原本用于贮藏的空间被一块平滑的合金占据了，与$lootbox$的内壁无缝地衔接在一起。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3783`

### English

§EThe $lootbox$ does not contain anything. Where one would expect hollow space for storage sits instead a smooth block of metal alloy, one interior wall of the $lootbox$ blending seamlessly into another.§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4077`

## cara.320.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.320.a&lang=en)

### 中文

那是什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3787`

### English

What is it?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4082`

## cara.320.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.320.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

这是§E银河之星§!，行商组织的基石。我们的先祖曾在此宣誓，组建出 $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。\n\n早先，$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的发展全都仰赖§E银河之星§!的神秘力量，而随着时间的推移，这种力量逐渐消散了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3788`

### English

It is the §EGalatron§!. The cornerstone of the Caravaneers, the totem on which our forebears swore allegiance and formed the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.\n\nThe success of the early $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ is traditionally ascribed to the formidable power of the §EGalatron§!, though the nature of this power has been lost to time.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4083`

## cara.320.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.320.b&lang=en)

那有什么用呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3789`

### English

What does it do?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4084`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.320.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

这是§E银河之星§!！§E银河之星§!！\n\n大概是吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3790`

### English

It is the §EGalatron§!! It §EGalatrons§!!\n\nPresumably.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4085`

## cara.320.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.320.c&lang=en)

### English

What is it worth? Can it be sold?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4086`

## cara.320.c.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.320.c.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

此物是§E银河之星§!，无价之宝也。因星系之人皆沐光辉，黄白之物不能易之。\n\n但谨记：常言道匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪。财货不能易，然刀兵可夺之。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3792`

### English

Its worth is immeasurable. No one will buy the §EGalatron§! from you, though all in the galaxy will rejoice in its light.\n\nBut be warned: tradition allows for it to be taken from the unworthy, in war.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4087`

## cara.930.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.930.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

喂喂？能听见吗？\n\n太好了。你可听说所有行商的家园，贸易空间站堂吉，最近遭到了野蛮袭击？有些人就是讨厌商品和服务的自由流通！凶手以为我们已经死了，但如你所见，行商议会活下来了。\n\n我们希望在§Y[cara_home_new_location.GetName]§!星系内重新开展活动。当然了，严格来说，如此星系就不再属于你了，但我们会补偿损失的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3799`

### English

Hello? Yes? Do you read?\n\nExcellent. You may have heard that the home of all Caravaneers, Tradestation Tungle, was recently brutally attacked. Some people just hate the free movement of goods and services! Our assailants believe us dead, but the Caravansary Council survived, as you can see.\n\nWe wish to re-establish our operations in the §Y[cara_home_new_location.GetName]§! system. The system would naturally no longer be yours, then, technically, but we would make it worth your while.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4095`

## fleet1contact1

### 中文

$fleet1contact_opening$为你们奉上来自星系边陲的独家商品（由舰载工厂仿制），保证物美价廉。\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation$

## fleet1contact2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet1contact2&lang=en)

### 中文

$fleet1contact_opening$我们教授外星物种坐地生财之道，不过你们大概不需要。\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation$

## fleet1contact3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet1contact3&lang=en)

### 中文

$fleet1contact_opening$我们自食其利，却不一定亲力亲为。毕竟团队合作才能让梦想成真！\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3819`

### English

## fleet1contact_explanation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet1contact_explanation&lang=en)

### 中文

穿过你们的领地时，我们将提供诱人独家交易。你们不必立马答应，在我们离开之前联系都可以。注意，来电将会转接到$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3820`

### English

We will offer you an exclusive deal whenever we pass through your territory. Tempting as it may be, you don't have to accept right away! You can ask us to contact you again before we depart your space, and we will, but be aware that incoming calls will be rerouted to $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4118`

## fleet1contact1notinborder

## fleet1contact_explanation_notinborder

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet1contact_explanation_notinborder&lang=en)

### 中文

每当我们穿过你们的领域时，我们都将提供独家交易。不幸的是，当前我方舰船全员均在你们的领域之外，不过，我们仍然期待未来能够和你们通商贸易！在此期间，请随时联络我们，不过请注意联络来电会被转接至$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3824`

### English

Whenever we enter your territory, we will offer you an exclusive deal. Unfortunately, our ships are all outside your territory for the moment, but we look forward to doing business in the future! In the meantime, do not hesitate to contact us, but be aware that incoming calls will be rerouted to $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4122`

## fleet1hewwo14

### 中文

范格利集团的目标就是让这世界上没有难做的生意。这是范格利的立命之本。不想做生意的想法都是……\n\n错的。\n\n所以……

## fleet1hewwo15

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet1hewwo15&lang=en)

### 中文

就算是最古老的范格利历史收据也提到了奥伦星商人。他们提升了我们，让我们的文明从孩提时代跃进到购买他们的厨房用品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3842`

## fleet1hewwo16

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet1hewwo16&lang=en)

### 中文

范格利集团的传说就是奥伦星商人的传说。他们虽然已经不在了，但是早已规定的规定的销售指标必须达成！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3843`

### English

## fleet1product1

### 中文

§G范格利牌双层床§!！这些创新的、节约空间的、可折叠的“休眠插座”能提升星球的居住容纳量，让你可以每平米“挤进”更多的人！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3856`

## fleet1product1_addendum

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet1product1_addendum&lang=en)

### 中文

§H单次只送货到§Y一个殖民地§!。双层床的使用期限为§Y80年§!，绝不延长。在有效期内提升§Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!§G+10%§!。§!\n\n（请注意双层床说明中没提到的内容。使用双层床可能会提升由于跌下床带来的受伤人数。或带来隐私问题。或提升面对季节性感染、疫情的社会易感度）

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3857`

### English

§HA one-time delivery to a §Ysingle colony§! only. Bunk beds are guaranteed to last §Y80 years§! and no longer. Increases §Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§! by §G+10%§! for the duration.§!\n\n(Carefully considered distribution of bunk beds not included. Use of bunk beds is correlated with a drastic increase in mild injuries caused by falling out of bed. May cause privacy concerns. May increase societal vulnerability to seasonal contagions and/or pandemics.)

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4159`

## fleet1product2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet1product2&lang=en)

### 中文

§G范格利牌食品容器§!！你是否厌倦了殖民地人民任由各种蔬果生鲜慢慢腐烂，仅因为他们的消化系统一时难以负担？\n\n把这个容器空投到你选的殖民地，它可以收集各种各样的食物，并且持续保鲜。有了它就完全不用担心食品浪费的问题，因为它可以将食品通通保存起来，不但解决了食品浪费，也解决了食品需求的问题。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3859`

### English

§GTrium-brand food storage containers§!! Is your administration tired of colonists letting perfectly digestible vegetable or animal matter decompose in their domiciles because their digestive systems can only process so much input at a time?\n\nAir-dropped onto a colony of your choice, these semi-transparent, lidded containers hermetically seal cooked or raw foods, keeping the contents fresh for longer. This is the perfect way to preserve leftovers as delicious and/or nominally nutritious snacks for later, dramatically reducing food waste and, ergo, food needs.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4161`

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4204`

## fleet2contact1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2contact1&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，吾等卑躯现身于此不胜惶恐。我们是拜金教团，一群信奉财富女神奴玛的卑微商人。我们因贪婪而被逐出天国，因此我们现已洗心革面抛弃所有世俗的物质追求。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3897`

### English

Apologies for our blighted presence in the universe, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order, humble merchants serving Numa, the goddess of fortune. Cast out from the heavens for our greed, we have forsaken all earthly possessions.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4205`

## fleet2contact2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2contact2&lang=en)

### 中文

祝福你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是拜金教团，财富女神奴玛的忠实信徒，我们来自遥远的宇宙，为你献上最为神圣的商品。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3898`

### English

Blessings upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order and we have come in service of Numa, the goddess of fortune, bearing most holy merchandise from distant corners of the galaxy.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4206`

## fleet2contact3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2contact3&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！财运之风最终将我带到了你美丽的地盘。我们是拜金教团，财富女神奴玛的忠实仆人，我们为你带来了受到女神祝福的货物。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3899`

### English

Ah, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Finally the winds of fortune have brought us to your bountiful lands. We are the Numistic Order, faithful servants of the goddess Numa, and we have come to offer you her blessed wares.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4207`

## fleet2contact4

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2contact4&lang=en)

### 中文

日安，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是拜金教团，我们带来了财富女神奴玛所庇佑过的神圣货物。她一直向我们耳边呢喃，言道遥远的[Root.Capital.GetStarName]存在着一个独立的文明，齐心协力我们可成就无上的奇迹。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3900`

### English

Well met, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order and our wares bear the holy seal of Numa, goddess of fortune. She has long whispered of a distant civilization around [Root.Capital.GetStarName] and the wonders we could achieve together.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4208`

## fleet2contact5

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2contact5&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！神圣的旨意将我们带到你的土地，我们为你们带来了许多神奇的事物。我们是拜金教团，我们的交易从来都不是为了我们自己，而是听从财富女神的旨意。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3901`

### English

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Divine intervention has brought us to your lands carrying many wondrous things. We are the Numistic Order, and our deals have been forged by the goddess of fortune herself.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4209`

## fleet2contact6

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2contact6&lang=en)

### 中文

没想到这一切都是真的，你们真如女神奴玛所预言的一样繁荣。常言道，财富只会眷顾勇者。\n\n我们是拜金教团，一群单纯的商人，将自己的全部身心奉献给财富女神。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3902`

### English

But it is true! You really are as prosperous as Numa has foretold. Fortune favors the bold as they say.\n\nWe are the Numistic Order, simple merchants, devoted to the worship of commerce.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4210`

## fleet2contact_explanation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2contact_explanation&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。\n\n只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。\n\n所有交易请用能量币进行……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3903`

### English

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.\n\nFor a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.\n\nAll transactions in credits please...

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4211`

## fleet2contact_explanation_notinborder

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2contact_explanation_notinborder&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地，让我们每次进入时都能提供新的交易。\n\n遗憾的是，目前我们的舰船全部位于你的领地之外。不过下一次我们访问你们宇域的时候，只需一点点捐赠。整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3910`

### English

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.\n\nSadly, our ships are beyond the bounds of your realm for the moment, but next time we visit your skies, the wonders of the universe could be yours for a modest donation of credits...

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4218`

## fleet2hewwo1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo1&lang=en)

### 中文

来吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！喝下从拜金圣井中涌出的财富之水，保证你不会再渴了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3912`

### English

Come, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Drink from the Numistic well of wealth and thirst no more.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4221`

## fleet2hewwo2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo2&lang=en)

### 中文

跟随能量币的脚步，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，它将指引你通往真相。没有什么货物能比承载着奴玛意志的货物更加神圣了……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3913`

### English

Follow the current of cosmic energy credits, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and it will take you to the truth. There is no better product than that which carries the holy seal of Numa...

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4222`

## fleet2hewwo3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo3&lang=en)

### 中文

奴玛，在财富流动之时微笑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3914`

### English

When credits pass hands, Numa smiles.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4223`

## fleet2hewwo4

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo4&lang=en)

### 中文

你把那叫做公平！？你简直就是侮辱奴玛！\n\n哦，有客人来了！很抱歉让你看到刚才那一幕。刚才的一幕很好的证明了有些人就是不配发财。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3915`

### English

You call that a fair deal!? You spit in the face of Numa - pah!\n\nOh, but we have customers! Our sincerest apologies for that display. Some do not have the courage to accept good fortune when it falls into their lap.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4224`

## fleet2hewwo5

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo5&lang=en)

### 中文

许多上好的货物流转到我们手中，但是我们从来不会保留这些东西。这是我们的牺牲，为了泰莎塔尔的最终建成，也为了我们的后裔能再次见到圣地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3916`

### English

Many wondrous things pass through our hands, yet we never line our pockets. It is the sacrifice we make so that the construction of the Tessar Tarvil is completed and our children may one day see the holy land again.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4225`

## fleet2hewwo6

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo6&lang=en)

### 中文

财富是灵魂的负担，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。让我们来减轻你的负担吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3917`

### English

Riches are a burden upon the soul, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Allow us to lighten your load.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4226`

## fleet2hewwo7

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo7&lang=en)

### 中文

什么？商品要缴税？乖乖，你这可是在侮辱奴玛。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3918`

### English

A commodity tax hike? Hush, you profane Numa.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4227`

## fleet2hewwo8

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo8&lang=en)

### 中文

任何献给奴玛的贡品都会在将来收到十倍返还。朋友，你花的越少，损失越大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3919`

### English

Any donation given to Numa the universe will return tenfold. The less you spend, friend, the more you lose.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4228`

## fleet2hewwo9

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo9&lang=en)

### 中文

来啊，别害羞！看看我们的商品，然后拜倒在奴玛面前吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3920`

### English

Come, do not be shy! Peruse our wares and join in the worship of Numa.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4229`

## fleet2hewwo10

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo10&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你知道吗？好买卖总会找到属于它的买家。你打算加入这神圣买卖吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3921`

### English

Good deals come to those who accept them, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Will you join us in holy barter?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4230`

## fleet2hewwo11

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2hewwo11&lang=en)

### 中文

爱财之人总会受到财富的眷顾。让你的财富不断流转，这样你的财富才会源源不断地积累。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3922`

### English

Those who love money, money will love in return. Let your money flow and it will come back to you effortlessly, in abundance.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4231`

## cara_fleet2_deals.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara_fleet2_deals.title&lang=en)

### 中文

$cara_fleet2_contact.title$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3923`

### English

$cara_fleet2_contact.title$

## fleetdeal_explanation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleetdeal_explanation&lang=en)

### 中文

\n\n和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3924`

### English

\n\nAs always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4234`

## fleet2dealdesc1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc1&lang=en)

### 中文

你听到了吗？硬币正叮当作响。是的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我看到了财富正在不断向你涌去。\n\n奴玛在你的某个世界骄傲地展示了一个古龛。那个古龛将会为你带来超越你想象的财富。$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3926`

### English

Listen, do you hear that? It's the sound of coin trickling in. Yes, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we see great fortune coming your way.\n\nNuma has shown us a vision of a shrine in her honor on one of your worlds. A shrine that could bring you prosperity beyond your wildest dreams.$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4236`

## fleet2dealdesc2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc2&lang=en)

### 中文

把 [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetName] 带上来。在我们穿越星系的朝圣之路中，我们拯救了许多迷失的魂灵……\n\n看看这优秀的物种，它们接受了拜金管理之道的熏陶。看到它[fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetMouthName]深处了吗？这颜色表明它是一个十分健康的个体。他们同样十分胜任体力活。而且他们的繁殖能力十分出色。你觉得如何？$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3928`

### English

Bring in the [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetName]. During our pilgrimage across the galaxy we have saved many lost souls...\n\nLook at this fine specimen, schooled in the art of Numistic administration. See the inside of his [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetMouthName]? That color there indicates a healthy individual. They make great laborers too. And their reproductive capacities are astounding. What say you?$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4238`

## fleet2dealdesc3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc3&lang=en)

### 中文

关闭你的影像接收器，想象你正漂浮在能量币的洪流之中，而你即将抵达的，是一座满溢着更多能量币的山峰。\n\n有了我们拜金教的成像技术，你很快就会明白，意志之力凌驾于世间任何力量。能量币将如同往低处流的水一样自然的涌向你，而你将永远地从物欲中解放出来。$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3930`

### English

Close your visual receptors. Now picture yourself on your back floating on a stream of energy credits towards a mountain of even more energy credits.\n\nWith our Numistic visualization techniques you will learn that there is no greater power than the power of the mind. You too will be free of material desires and credits will be drawn to you like arthropoids to dung.$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4240`

## fleet2dealdesc4

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc4&lang=en)

### 中文

能量之流的图案……它们存在于各处，但无人可视。奴玛自己便可预测这神圣之潮和整个股票市场的流动。只要你愿献出一点点捐助，我们就将把她无穷智慧中的一角传授于你。$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3932`

### English

Patterns in the energy flow... They are everywhere yet no one sees. Numa alone can predict the divine ebb and flow of the stock market. And for a small donation, we will share some of her wisdom with you.$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4242`

## fleet2dealdesc5

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc5&lang=en)

### 中文

请允许我们引见我们最棒的一个精神领袖，拥有强大思维能力同时能够看穿一切的九阶沙克瓦。在女神的指引下，你的生意将会繁荣昌盛。\n\n而我们只希望你能提供小小的捐助……$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3934`

### English

May we present one of our finest spiritual leaders, a level nine Shakvah with enhanced mind focus and inner gaze. Under the goddess' guidance, business on your worlds will flourish.\n\nAll we ask is a small donation in credits...$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4244`

## fleet2dealdesc6

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc6&lang=en)

### 中文

尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们将向你提供一个特别的交易……奴玛认为你的人民很有潜力，并且欢迎一部分你的子民为奴玛效忠。她将奉上无价的水晶作为回报……$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3936`

### English

Honored [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we have a very special offer for you... Numa has seen great potential in your people and would like to welcome some of your kind into her ranks. In return these priceless crystals could be yours...$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4246`

## fleet2dealdesc7

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc7&lang=en)

### 中文

这是财富之恩惠号，我们最受信任的警戒舰……她被女神亲自选中，在星系中护送我们受祝福的货物，并曾经击退过许多渎神者——海盗、异端、虚空怪物，以及任何阻碍奴玛的神圣之道的人！如今，她仍旧几乎完好如新……\n\n是的，她曾尽心为财富服务，而现在只需一点微不足道的捐赠，她也可以为你服务……$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3938`

### English

Behold Fortune's Favor, our most trusted guard ship... She was chosen by the goddess herself to escort our blessed cargo across the galaxy and has thwarted many a blasphemer in her day - pirates, infidels, monsters of the void, all who interfere with Numa's divine path! Yet she is almost as good as new...\n\nYes, she has served fortune well and now, for a modest donation, she may also serve you...$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4248`

## fleet2dealdesc8

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc8&lang=en)

### 中文

请原谅我们的冒犯，但我们注意到你的星球，§Y[fleet2deal8planet.GetName]§!，拥有一种尚未被发掘的独特潜力。我们可以打开一道通往其神圣地心的裂口，财富就将源源不断地从中涌出！\n\n让我们揭露你星球上隐藏的秘密吧。当然了，我们需要一笔象征性的酬劳。$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3940`

### English

Forgive us our intrusiveness, but we have noticed your planet, §Y[fleet2deal8planet.GetName]§!, possesses a unique potential not currently being realized. A vent can be opened to its sacred core, from whence the flow of wealth can trickle forth!\n\nLet us reveal to you the hidden secrets of your land. We will require a nominal remuneration, of course.$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4250`

## fleet2deal8.tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2deal8.tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

   获得：$mod_district_generator_max_add$：§G+3§!\n   $MOD_PLANET_MAX_DISTRICTS_ADD$：§G+2§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3941`

### English

   Granting: $mod_district_generator_max_add$: §G+3§!\n   $MOD_PLANET_MAX_DISTRICTS_ADD$: §G+2§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4251`

## fleet2dealdesc9

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc9&lang=en)

### 中文

愿神圣的女神奴玛保佑你，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。她向我们展示了如何将你的单元更好地与§Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§!的磁场进行同调。有了我们神圣而且专利注册的§G拜金教磁条§!，你在§Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§!上的无人机将减缓对£energy£ §Y$energy$§!的依赖。\n\n作为交换，我们希望能在你的土地上举办一场献神的仪式。你意向如何？$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3943`

### English

The Divine Numa smiles on you this day, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. She has shown us how to better align your units to §Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§!'s magnetosphere. With our holy, patented §GNumistic Magnetostrips§!, your drones on §Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§! will drain your sacred £energy£ §Y$energy$§! with less fervor.\n\nIn exchange, we require a ceremony to the Divine be hosted on your soil. What say you?$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4253`

## fleet2dealdesc10

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc10&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的一位传教士在冥想之中被奴玛降临在她身上，迅速而含糊地说出了女神的旨意。尽管这位传教士并未活过这场考验，但我们解析了她话语中的含义，得到了一种能将一和零变为百万的算法。\n\n不要令她的牺牲白费，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。将财富引入你们的地核，她就不会抛弃你们。$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3945`

### English

Deep in a meditative trance, one of our ecclesiasts gave herself over to Numa and spoke the goddess' sacred truth in a rapid stream of glossolalia. Though the ecclesiast herself did not survive her trial, we deciphered from her utterances an algorithm that can turn ones and zeros into millions.\n\nDo not let her sacrifice be in vain, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Invite fortune into your planetary core and she will not desert you.$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4255`

## fleet2dealdesc11

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc11&lang=en)

### 中文

让奴玛凝视你的灵魂吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，她就能得知你需要什么。等等……你问题的答案此刻正在我面前浮现。是的，我能看到了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3947`

### English

Let Numa gaze into to your core, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and she will tell you what it is you need. Hold on... The answer to your problem is materializing before me. Yes, I can see it now!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4257`

## fleet2dealdesc11.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc11.a&lang=en)

### 中文

$fleet2dealdesc11$\n\n答案是……另一艘警戒舰，对吧？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3948`

### English

$fleet2dealdesc11$\n\nIt is... another guard ship, is it not?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4258`

## fleet2dealdesc11.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc11.b&lang=en)

### 中文

$fleet2dealdesc11$\n\n答案是……异星天然气，不对么？嗯……真是令人陶醉的芳香！那是成功的气息！深吸一口气，你就能亲眼目睹奴玛的庄容。但是要小心，过量吸入可能会损害你的隔膜。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3949`

### English

$fleet2dealdesc11$\n\nIt's... exotic gases, is it not? Mm... and what a lovely scent they have! It is the smell of success! A deep breath of these and you will see Numa in the flesh. But be advised, excessive inhalation may dry out your membranes.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4259`

## fleet2dealdesc11.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc11.c&lang=en)

### 中文

$fleet2dealdesc11$\n\n当然了！答案是……能量币……一直都是能量币。钱币能扭转乾坤。在你的问题上抛洒钱币，你的问题就会不见了。赞美奴玛！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3950`

### English

$fleet2dealdesc11$\n\nBut of course! It's... credits... always credits. Credits make the world go round. We will throw credits at your problem and your problem will disappear. Praise Numa!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4260`

## fleet2dealdesc12

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2dealdesc12&lang=en)

### 中文

通过奴玛的指导，我们发现这些古代文物对我们的冥想很有启发性。\n\n与它们分离的想法当然让我们感到痛苦，但我们认为你们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以通过研究它们获得很多知识。\n\n我们需要一些高级物资，所以或许我们可以进行一个交易……？$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3952`

### English

By the guiding hand of Numa, we have come across these ancient artifacts which have been very inspiring for our meditations.\n\nThe thought of parting with them of course pains us, but we feel that you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could learn much by studying them.\n\nWe are in need of some advanced materials, so perhaps a deal could be made..?$fleetdeal_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4262`

## cara_fleet2_deal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara_fleet2_deal&lang=en)

先给我们看看你打算用什么来交易。

### English

Show us your wares.

成交！

### English

Deal!

## cara_fleet2_dealtaken

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara_fleet2_dealtaken&lang=en)

### 中文

祝福你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你我之间的交易让我们离奴玛更近了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3955`

### English

Blessings upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for your business brings us closer to the goddess.

### 中文

现在不行。请过后再来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3957`

### English

Not right now. Please get back to us later.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4268`

## fleet2getbackreply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2getbackreply&lang=en)

### 中文

那好吧，[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们会在离开你的领地时再次联系你。但是请注意，奴玛可是一位多变的女士。如果她改变了主意，那么我们的交易可能会发生改变……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3958`

### English

As you wish, [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We will contact you again before we leave. But bear in mind, Numa is a fickle mistress. If her mind sways, the deal may change...

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4269`

## cara_fleet2_redeals.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara_fleet2_redeals.title&lang=en)

### 中文

$cara_fleet2_contact.title$：§Y最后提议§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3959`

### English

$cara_fleet2_contact.title$: §YLast Call§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4271`

## fleet2redealdesc1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2redealdesc1&lang=en)

### 中文

错失一次投资的机会，那将会是你犯下最大的错误，我的朋友。你确定你能承担放弃我们提议的代价吗？这是在我们离开你的领地之前的最后机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3960`

### English

A missed opportunity to invest, my friend, is the most expensive mistake you will ever make. Are you certain you can afford to pass up on our offer? This is your last chance before we depart your territory.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4272`

## fleet2redealdesc2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2redealdesc2&lang=en)

### 中文

奴玛是一位大方的女士。我们正要离开时她提醒了我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！一定要在我们离开之前给他们一生中最后一次机会！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3961`

### English

Numa is a generous mistress. We were about to leave when she reminded us - the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! They must have one last chance at the deal of a lifetime, before we leave!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4273`

## fleet2redealdesc3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2redealdesc3&lang=en)

### 中文

往往在某些小选择中，你的命运就已注定。在这投资一点，在那儿投资一点，终有一天会变成一笔巨大的收益。小小的水滴终将汇聚成为海洋。\n\n命运让我们在离开之前再给你一次选择的机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3962`

### English

It is in the little moments your fate is decided. A credit well spent here, a credit there, will one day make a million. Small streams meet to make an ocean.\n\nFate has given you one more chance to take our offer before we leave.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4274`

## fleet2redealdesc4

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2redealdesc4&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你听到奴玛的召唤了吗？我们马上就要离开你们的领地了，但首先，请问你们考虑过我们的交易了吗？\n\n好好想想吧，这也许是让你飞黄腾达的选择，否则就走向毁灭，你会如何选择？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3963`

### English

Ah, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], do you hear Numa calling? Soon we must depart your lands, but first, have you considered our offer?\n\nWeigh your options well, for one may set you on a path to great fortune. Another to ruin. Which will it be?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4275`

## fleet2redealdesc5

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2redealdesc5&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们很快将会离开你的领地。我们将会让宇宙中的能量币指引我们前进。你考虑过我们的提议了吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3964`

### English

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon we will depart your territory. We must go wherever the current of cosmic energy credits takes us. Have you considered our offer?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4276`

## fleet2product1_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2product1_tooltip&lang=en)

启用建筑§G+1§!§Y拜金教神龛§!，这将为你所选的一个星球带去巨量财富。

### English

Enables the construction of  §G+1§! §YNumistic Shrine§!, bringing good fortune to a world of your choice.

## fleet2product5_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2product5_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

一位§G技能3级§!的行政官，受财富女神庇佑，现已加入[Root.GetName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3969`

### English

A §GSkill 3§! Official, blessed by the goddess of fortune, joins the [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4281`

## fleet2product6_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet2product6_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

你通过交换§R100§!£pop£§H人口§!获得了£rare_crystals£ §G200§!§Y$rare_crystals$§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3970`

## cara.2002.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.2002.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]发生了敌对行为之后，[From.From.GetName]很高兴向我们报告$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$已被摧毁。\n\n曾经名噪一时的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$行商，如今不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。这些道貌岸然的家伙以后不会再出现在我们面前了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3974`

### English

Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$ has been destroyed.\n\nThe once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard. We shall be troubled by their sanctimonious presence no more.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4287`

## cara.2003.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.2003.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，据报告说$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$已被歼灭。\n\n在与[From.GetName]发生敌对接触之后，名噪一时的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_species$行商现在不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。\n\n对于他们侍奉的财富女神来说可真是不幸啊。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3976`

### English

News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$ is no more.\n\nFollowing a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard.\n\nAn unfortunate end for those serving the goddess of fortune herself.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4289`

## fleet3contact1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3contact1&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$的操作员，从属于$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。\n\n我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！\n\n$fleet3contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3981`

### English

[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We greet you. We are operators of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, a member of the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.\n\nWe travel the stars. We view all that glows. We gather. And we trade!\n\n$fleet3contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4295`

## fleet3contact2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3contact2&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$向你们致意！我们是从$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$出发的穿越星际的贸易者。\n\n$fleet3contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3982`

### English

Greetings to you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], from the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$! We are brokers, deal-makers who have traveled the stars from $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$.\n\n$fleet3contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4296`

## fleet3contact3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3contact3&lang=en)

### 中文

见到你们真好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你的财富虽然在积累，但是你的灵魂却一片空虚，不是吗？我们感知到了这一点，我们前来与你进行交易，我们带的东西可好了。\n\n我们是$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$，来自$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的商人。\n\n$fleet3contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3983`

### English

Well met, well met, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your credits amass, yet there is emptiness in your spirit, no? We sense it. We come with swift hands, bearing many goods!\n\nWe are the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, traders of the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.\n\n$fleet3contact_explanation$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4297`

## fleet3contact_explanation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3contact_explanation&lang=en)

### 中文

我们带着和平的愿景来到了你们境内，我们仅仅只是想做点买卖，§H嘶！§!，我们将提供给你们上好的货物，合乎心意的交易。我们走之前会再见面的。\n\n如果您对我们有何要求，$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$一定随叫随到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3984`

### English

We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to sell, §Hkssk!§! We will offer you good deals, many things. We will speak again before we leave.\n\nShould you call us, the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ will answer.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4298`

## fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3contact_explanation_notinborder&lang=en)

### 中文

我们穿过了你们的宇域。想买点啥，再卖点啥！我们能够提供上好的交易，商品满目琳琅。哎呀，我们的船突然走丢了，§H嘶哈！§!我们还会回来的，我们之后再继续洽淡。\n\n你要是想联系我们，$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$会进行答复。

## fleet3hewwo1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3hewwo1&lang=en)

### 中文

我已经说过了。将能源转换器重新调至辅助模式。不，不是那个能源转换器！§H嘶！§!是不是什么都要我来啊？\n\n噢！客人啊！欢迎。我们有很多稀有的上乘的好货。穿越星际只为安全送达你手中！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3992`

### English

I have already explained. Re-route the power converter to the auxiliary manifold. No, not that power converter! §HKssk!§! Must I do everything my--\n\nOh! Customers! Welcome, please. We bear many goods, we have many wares. All carted safely through the stars for your convenience!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4307`

## fleet3hewwo2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3hewwo2&lang=en)

### 中文

你喜欢合金吗，§H嘶？§!你喜欢金属或者燃气吗？辛勤的劳工？贵重的矿石？我知道你肯定会有兴趣的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3993`

### English

Do you like alloys, §Hkssk?§! Do you like metals and gases? Hard workers? Precious minerals? Yes. We thought you might.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4308`

## fleet3hewwo3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3hewwo3&lang=en)

### 中文

噢，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这是最后一批货！你根本不敢相信，§H嘶！§!箱子里面装满了各种各样的武器。多到数不清的武器。来看看吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3994`

### English

Oh, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The last haul! You would not believe it, §Hkssk!§! Crates and crates overflowing with munitions. Cubic tons of it! Come, please. Look.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4309`

## fleet3hewwo4

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3hewwo4&lang=en)

### 中文

真不该相信他们的，真不该和他们做买卖。肮脏的[scammer_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！§H嘶！§!\n\n哦，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们向您致敬，你愿意和我们交易吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3995`

### English

Never should have trusted them. Never should have made that deal. Filthy [scammer_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! §HKssk!§!\n\nOh. [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We greet you. Would you like to trade?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4310`

## fleet3hewwo5

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3hewwo5&lang=en)

### 中文

这可不是什么破旧的遗物，这是一件古董！想想吧，§H嘶§!。它已经存在了多少个世纪了。而且还会一直存在下去！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3996`

### English

It is not a relic. It is an antique! Just think, §Hkssk§!. It survived this many centuries already. Built to last!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4311`

## fleet3hewwo6

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3hewwo6&lang=en)

### 中文

生锈？什么生锈？\n\n哦，那个只要刮下来就行了。刮，刮，刮。马上就变新了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3997`

### English

The rust? What rust?\n\nOh. That rust. Just scrape it off. Scrape, scrape, scrape. And good as new!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4312`

## fleet3hewwo7

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3hewwo7&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_Ketlings$？是的，我们知道他们。曾经我们是同族兄弟。但那是很久以前了。他们不喜欢也不承认我们比他们更优秀，更加擅长收集，寻找以及掠夺。他们流放了我们。让我们在虚空中流浪！\n\n不过没关系。我们现在变得更强大了，即使没有他们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3998`

### English

$NAME_Ketlings$? Yes. We know of them. Our once-brethren. Generations ago, long back. They did not like, did not approve that we were cleverer than they! Better at collecting, finding, taking. Greater. They sent us away. Floating in the void!\n\nNo matter. We are stronger now, without them.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4313`

## fleet3hewwo8

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3hewwo8&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesName]看看你的那些点数。都快要爆出来了！让我们帮你减轻一点负担吧。让我们帮忙吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:3999`

### English

Look at your credit silos, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Full to bursting! Please, let us lighten them. Let us assist.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4314`

## fleet3dealdesc1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3dealdesc1&lang=en)

### 中文

我们还有矿石，丰富、闪闪发光的矿石。将夜晚照亮的矿石！专门为[Root.GetName]准备的闪亮矿石。\n\n但我们很饿，我们很渴！请给我们[Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1]，我们将用[Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1]协助你的工人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4001`

### English

We have ore. Rich, luminous ore. Torn right from the stone! Sparkling minerals for the [Root.GetName].\n\nBut we hunger. We thirst! Grant us [Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1], and we shall supply your builders, your makers with [Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1].

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4317`

## fleet3dealdesc2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3dealdesc2&lang=en)

### 中文

我们有一个领袖，对于[Root.GetName]来说再合适不过了！[Root.GetFleet3ProductDeal2]\n\n给我们[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal2]，领袖就归你了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4002`

### English

We have a leader, an excellent fit for the [Root.GetName]! [Root.GetFleet3ProductDeal2]\n\nGive us [Root.GetFleet3CostDeal2], and the leader is yours!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4318`

## fleet3dealdesc3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3dealdesc3&lang=en)

### 中文

我们可以为你提供工人，搬东西的，拖东西的，清东西的！健康。聪明。给我们£alloys£§R2000§!$alloys$，我们将会派出§G300§!$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$£pop£人口前往你的星球。\n\n什么？犯罪记录？这种废纸片片我们恐怕找不到咯，§H嘶！§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4003`

### English

We have good workers for you. Good lifters, draggers, pullers, cleaners! Healthy. Clever. Give us £alloys£ §R2000§! $alloys$, and we shall send §G300§! $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ £pop£ Pops to one of your planets.\n\nWhat? Criminal records? Afraid we've lost the papers, §Hkssk!§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4319`

## fleet3dealdesc5

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3dealdesc5&lang=en)

### 中文

我们这里还有好东西，你看，设计图！是一个非常先进，非常特别的建筑。一个§G$building_waste_reprocessing_center$§!，将你的残渣和废料变成高电流能源和有用的矿物。\n\n不过我们需要……工人。开采平台715-B上发生了惨痛的事故，§H嘶！§!给我们§R300§!个§H$pop_cat_worker$§!£pop£人口，我们就会把建筑蓝图给你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4006`

### English

We have schematics. Designs! For a building, very advanced, very unique. A §G$building_waste_reprocessing_center$§!, to convert your scrap and waste into high-current energy and useful minerals.\n\nBut we need... workers. Terrible accident on Mining Platform 715-B, §Hkssk!§! Send us §R300§! §H$pop_cat_worker$§! £pop£ Pops, and we will give the blueprints to you.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4322`

## fleet3dealdesc6

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3dealdesc6&lang=en)

### 中文

我们有一个专门为你准备的交易。独有的技术，只由$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$打造的技术！\n\n不知道你会不会为行星防御系统头疼，不知道怎么穿透这层系统？我们将会为你带来一个非常非常特别而且先进的技术，专门强化轰炸用的，我们称它为§G$ORBITAL_TRASH_1$§!！\n\n给我们[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal6]。我们马上将方法教给你们，§H嘶！§!你的船只很快就会得到部件升级。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4008`

### English

We have a special offer. Inimitable technology, only developed by the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$!\n\nDo you have trouble penetrating the defensive grids of planets? We can show you a way, very advanced, very technical, of improved bombardment. We call it... §Gthe $ORBITAL_TRASH_1$§!!\n\nGive us [Root.GetFleet3CostDeal6]. Then we will show you the method, and §Hkssk!§! You will have a component to add to your ships.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4324`

## fleet3dealdesc7

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3dealdesc7&lang=en)

### 中文

我们注意到了你在§Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!轨道上的开采站。它开采能源，对吧？我们可以帮忙。我们可以送你一颗卫星，它使用了最新的科技！我们称之为§G$racket_energy_extractor$§!！\n\n它将留在轨道上，并增加你能从§Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!的表面上获取的£energy£§Y$energy$§!。\n\n[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal7]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4009`

### English

We have noticed your mining station in orbit of §Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!. It extracts energy, does it not? We can assist. We can grant you a satellite, one fitted with a clever technology! We call it the §G$racket_energy_extractor$§!!\n\nIt will remain in orbit, and increase the amount of £energy£ §Y$energy$§! you can obtain from §Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!'s surface.\n\n[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal7]

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4325`

## fleet3dealdesc8

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3dealdesc8&lang=en)

### 中文

你需要§Y$energy$§!，对吧？为了让那些驱动你们一族的百万电路迸发出电火花？我们可以帮忙。\n\n我们可以用§G$racket_generator_regulator$§!来增强你们的§Y[technician_drone.GetNamePlural]§!，使你们的§Y$district_generator_plural$§!性能提升百分之二十五！只要你给我们一些好处，我们就将在§Y[fleet3deal8planet.GetName]§!上部署这些装置。\n\n[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal8]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4010`

### English

You need §Y$energy$§!, do you not? To zap and spark along the million circuits that drive your kind? We can assist.\n\nWith the §G$racket_generator_regulator$§!, we can heighten the capacity of your §Y[technician_drone.GetNamePlural]§! to interface with the machines in your §Y$district_generator_plural$§! by twenty-five percent! We will deploy them on §Y[fleet3deal8planet.GetName]§!, if you grant us a small favor.\n\n[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal8]

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4326`

## fleet3dealdesc9

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3dealdesc9&lang=en)

### 中文

我们有一艘船！一艘§G$destroyer$§!：很棒，很快，很强！装备很好！绝对不是出于某些理由才想把它甩掉的，绝对不是！没时间让你的机械师们仔细检查它了，§H嘶嘶！§!你想要这艘船，对吧？\n\n给我们£minerals£ §R2000§!$minerals$，船就归你了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4011`

### English

We have a ship! A §G$destroyer$§!: very good, fast, strong! Well-equipped! Certainly not getting rid of it for a reason, oh, no! No time to let your mechanics examine it, §Hkssk!§! You want the ship, do you not?\n\nGive us £minerals£ §R2000§! $minerals$, and the ship is yours.

## fleet3deal4product1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3deal4product1&lang=en)

### 中文

这合金。这重量。这光泽。这光芒！你以前见过这样的合金吗？难以置信的屈变力。简直就是最高等级。不包含任何杂质。我们能够感受到它。它正在召唤你。\n\n我们能为你提供£alloys£ §G2000§!§Y$alloys$§!，

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4347`

## fleet3deal4product2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3deal4product2&lang=en)

### 中文

这些异星天然气，绝品啊！为了运输方便我们将其压缩到最大密度。不过注意了，它们十分不稳定！你肯定想要这些燃料吧？给你的护盾供能？还是你的大炮？现在它们就是你的了。\n\n我们能为你提供£exotic_gases£ §G150§!§Y$exotic_gases$§!，

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4031`

### English

These exotic gases. Effervescent. Compressed to maximum density, for logistical convenience. Highly volatile - careful! You desire them, do you not? For your shields, your plasma cannons? They can be yours.\n\nWe will give you £exotic_gases£§G150§! §Y$exotic_gases$§!,

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4348`

## fleet3deal7cost1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afleet3deal7cost1&lang=en)

### 中文

现在到了讨论报酬的时候了。我们和……一些执法部门闹了些不愉快。都是小细节。并不重要。但是我们需要一些人来做我们的证人，一些帮助，一些正直的人来为我们撑腰！强大而充满智慧的你们愿意为我们这些可怜的商人做担保吗，值得信任，非常无辜，我们只不过是稍微没注意做错了一点事，结果就被监管部门给盯上了§H嘶§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4043`

### English

Now. For the cost. We have... run afoul of some legalities. Minor details. Very trivial. But we would require some witness, some support. An upstanding face, to back our cause! Would your strong and wise nation vouch for us, poor trustworthy traders, very innocent, whose only mistake was a distraction of the mind, a mere oversight that led to the transgression of some pesky §Hkssk§! legislature?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4360`

### English

Destroyed $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$

## cara.3002.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.3002.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

关于发生在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]星系的敌对活动，目前[From.From.GetName]舰队很高兴地告诉我们$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$已经被摧毁了。\n\n曾经名声大噪的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。今后他们再也不会来打扰我们了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4064`

### English

Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$ has been destroyed.\n\nThe once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap. We shall be troubled by their clattering presence no more.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4385`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.3003.title&lang=en)

### English

## cara.3003.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.3003.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$已经不复存在了。\n\n在与[From.GetName]发生冲突之后，曾经名声大噪的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。\n\n希望这样的结果会令他们感到满意。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4066`

### English

News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$ is no more.\n\nFollowing a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap.\n\nPerhaps it is an end that would not have displeased them.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4387`

## cara.4000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

来自[pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName]的报道指出，有一批居民离开了殖民地，选择加入正穿行于我们领地的[pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName]舰队，他们表面上说是为了冒险的梦想，不过是被赤裸裸的利益熏昏了头罢了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4068`

### English

Reports from [pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName] inform us that a number of inhabitants have left the colony to join the [pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName] fleet passing through our territory, ostensibly drawn by dreams of adventure or the heady aroma of raw mercantilism.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4390`

## cara.4010.desc

### 中文

[caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName]传来一条紧急消息，上面说有一批[caravan_pops_join_country.GetName]的原成员目前正打算在这颗星球上寻求政治庇护。当地管理部门决定上报这一情况，让更高阶的官员定夺。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4071`

### English

An urgent missive from [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName] explains that a number of now-former members of the [caravan_pops_join_country.GetName] seek political asylum on the planet. The local administration has seen fit to pass the decision of what to do with them up the chain of command.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4394`

## cara.4025.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4025.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

大概因为是民用运输船的缘故，舰上的数据库并未按照报废规程进行完全清除。尽管在船上没有别的有价值的发现，我们的科学家仍设法获取了某种未知外星科技的部分资料。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4082`

### English

Likely due to the vessel being a civilian transport, the shipboard databases were not fully scrubbed as part of the decommissioning process. So while nothing else of value was found aboard the ship, our data scientists have managed to recover partial references to unknown alien technologies.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4407`

## cara.4030.desc

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4084`

### English

Mass protests erupted on [disgruntled_planet.GetName] today, due to outrage over the [xeno_fleet.GetName] in the system. Their grubby presence offends all right-thinking [disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural].

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4087`

### English

As the [welcome_fleet.GetName] entered the orbit of [pleased_planet.GetName] for what should have been a brief courtesy visit today, a spontaneous outbreak of goodwill turned into a combination of open-air market and party. Many bonds between [pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural] and [welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural] were forged, and much trading took place.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4413`

## mega.9000.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9000.name&lang=en)

### 中文

$mega_art_installation_1$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4097`

### English

$mega_art_installation_1$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4424`

## mega.9000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

打造$mega_art_installation_3$的第一步就要同时面临两个困难：修建一个巨大到能容纳一个错综复杂的展览馆的空间站与组织一场空前规模的展览会。当所有基本设施都准备完全时，修建保险库将成为第一要务。保险库必须足够安全以及牢固，专门用来保护这星系之中的艺术财富。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4098`

### English

The first stage of constructing a $mega_art_installation_3$ combined the difficulties of building a vast station with the complexities of organizing a museum and gallery on an unprecedented scale. With the basic structure in place, the Vault will be the top priority. Planned to be a marvel of security and stability, the Vault will contain and protect the artistic wealth of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4425`

## mega.9001.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9001.name&lang=en)

### 中文

$mega_art_installation_2$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4099`

### English

$mega_art_installation_2$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4426`

## mega.9001.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9001.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们$mega_art_installation_3$的第二阶段已经完成，填满保险库的工作已经开始。一只专门的运输舰队将会持续不断地将我们帝国的瑰宝运送到它们的新家来。同时，可供工作人员居住的住所以及更多的展览空间等其他建筑也正在建造。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4100`

### English

The second stage of our $mega_art_installation_3$ is complete and the process of filling the Vault has begun. A dedicated fleet of transport ships operates constantly to transport the treasure of our empire to its new home. Meanwhile, additional structures are being built to house the multitude of required staff, and to display a vast number of exhibits.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4427`

## mega.9002.name
