### 中文

$mega_art_installation_3$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4101`

### English

$mega_art_installation_3$

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4428`

## mega.9002.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9002.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展厅能够展示[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]和来自星系其他地区的满目琳琅以涤荡普罗大众的心灵。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4102`

### English

The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will display the artistry of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] and the galaxy to the delight of all. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4429`

## mega.9002.phile.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9002.phile.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展出来自星系各国的艺术臻品以彰显不同物种的多样性。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4103`

### English

The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will show samples of art from every race to celebrate the diversity of the galaxy. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4430`

## mega.9002.phobe.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9002.phobe.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展示[From.Owner.GetAdj]的真正艺术作品！同时还会展出一小部分外星艺术作为陪衬。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4104`

### English

The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will display the true glory of [From.Owner.GetAdj] art! A small selection of Xeno-art shall also be displayed for comparison and mockery. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4431`

## mega.9003.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9003.name&lang=en)

### 中文

战略指挥中心：外结构

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4105`

### English

Strategic Coordination Center: Hull

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4432`

## mega.9003.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9003.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地防御我国的计划服务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4106`

### English

The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to defend our empire.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4433`

## mega.9003.mil.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9003.mil.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地征服星海的计划服务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4107`

### English

The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to conquer the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4434`

## mega.9003.slave.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9003.slave.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地抓捕奴隶的计划服务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4108`

### English

The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to capture the maximum number of slaves.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4435`

## mega.9004.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9004.name&lang=en)

### 中文

战略指挥中心：通讯

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4109`

### English

Strategic Coordination Center: Comms

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4436`

## mega.9004.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9004.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

强大的通信阵列已被加入到战略指挥中心之中，这样我们的舰船无论在哪都可以收到来自于我们的战略指令了。这些目前最为先进的通信阵列能够克服一切干扰，并且它量子纠缠的信号完全无法被破解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4110`

### English

Powerful communication arrays have been added to the Strategic Coordination Center, enabling our strategists to issue orders to our ships throughout the galaxy. These state-of-the-art arrays are powerful enough to burn through any possible jamming, and the quantum-entangled signal is utterly unhackable.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4437`

## mega.9005.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9005.name&lang=en)

### 中文

战略指挥中心：全面运行

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4111`

### English

Strategic Coordination Center: Operational

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4438`

## mega.9005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

战略指挥中心最后的附加部分是一些分离的\"敌方军队\"模拟堡垒。这些堡垒差不多就是战略指挥中心的微缩版，而且完全独立运行。精英指挥官和他的手下们在其中能够完整地沉浸在敌人的文化与传统之中，通过学习他们的艺术，能更好地理解并模拟他们的军事思想。当完全沉浸之后，他们会与战略指挥中心的工作人员开展一场场虚拟战争，使得我们能够模拟任何可能的冲突，并能从两边学习到所有的细节，我们便能够在实战当中拥有比敌人更加卓越的战术。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4112`

### English

The final additions to the Strategic Coordination Center are several detached "Hostile force" simulator bastions. These bastions contain much of the functionality of the Strategic Coordination Center on a smaller scale, but are completely independent of the main system. Within, elite commanders and their staff can become totally immersed in the culture and traditions of our enemies, and by studying their artwork can better understand and simulate their military thinking. Once fully immersed, they will fight virtual wars against the staff of the Strategic Coordination Center, allowing us to stimulate conflicts with any possible enemy in excruciating detail which can then be studied from the perspectives of both sides and our strategies refined upon.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4439`

## mega.9006.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9006.name&lang=en)

### 中文

星际集会：基座

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4113`

### English

Interstellar Assembly: Locus

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4440`

## mega.9006.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9006.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星际集会第一阶段最关键的特征的就是§S基座§!了。一个复杂的黑洞全息影像，它被用来召唤星系中心潜伏的引力深渊：那整个星系旋转的支点。\n\n等到建成之后，这个地方也将会成为某些事务的轴心，那些能驱使整个星河旋转的静默外交与软实力博弈将会紧紧围绕着它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4114`

### English

The most crucial feature of the initial stage of the Interstellar Assembly is the §SLocus§!. A sophisticated holographic projection of a black hole, it is meant to evoke the gravitational chasm that lurks in the galactic core: the fulcrum upon which the galaxy turns.\n\nOnce fully built, this place will also be an axle of sorts, around which the quiet diplomacy and soft power that often drive the galaxy swirl.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4441`

## mega.9007.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9007.name&lang=en)

### English

## mega.9007.desc

### 中文

星际集会的第二阶段，领事环，现已建成。这个内环将能够容下我们大部分的外交人员在里面活动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4116`

### English

The second stage of the Interstellar Assembly, the Consul Ring, is now complete. This inner circle will house most of our diplomatic staff going forward.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4443`

### English

Interstellar Assembly: Forum Modules

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4444`

## mega.9008.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9008.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星际集会的外环将会配有大量最先进的隐私保护会议室（当然，只有[Root.GetAdj]能够进行监控）。这座空间站正在迅速成为非现场谈判方面无可辩驳的星系枢纽。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4118`

### English

The Interstellar Assembly's outer ring is populated with vast, state-of-the-art conference rooms equipped with privacy filters (penetrable only by [Root.GetAdj] surveillance, of course). The station is quickly becoming the de-facto galactic hub for off-site negotiations.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4445`

## mega.9009.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9009.name&lang=en)

### 中文

星际集会

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4119`

### English

Interstellar Assembly

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4446`

## mega.9009.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9009.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星际集会已全力运作，目前正在招待星际间几股大势力的重要人物们，无论他们是政界还是商界的。\n\n我们的外交官们在跟进空间站内传出的那些国家利益与政治羞辱的信息流时受了不少累。不过至少我们的客人对我们的监控并不关心，只要我们一直为他们提供这种同竞争对手角力的理想环境就好了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4120`

### English

The Interstellar Assembly is now fully operational, and plays host to a number of embassies from the galaxy's major powers, be they political or corporate.\n\nOur diplomats are having a hard time keeping up with the steady flow of information on national interests and political embarrassments we are extracting from the station. At least our guests seem largely disinterested in our surveillance, as long as we provide the ideal environs for them to strong-arm their competitors.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4447`

## mega.9010.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9010.name&lang=en)

### 中文

物质解压器：锚定

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4121`

### English

Matter Decompressor: Anchor

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4448`

## mega.9010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了对[From.GetName]进行开采，我们首先需要一个安全基地才能开始建造其他。星锚已经在黑洞事件视界的最边缘处建造完成，并且已经由一个重力重定向引擎牢牢稳定住，通过逆转[From.GetName]自身产生的重力去抵抗巨大的引力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4122`

### English

To extract matter from [From.GetName] we first need a secure base to build the facility on. The Anchor has been built on the very edge of the event horizon and is held in place against the immense gravitational pull by an advanced gravity redirection engine, which turns [From.GetName]'s own gravity against it.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4449`

## mega.9011.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9011.name&lang=en)

### 中文

物质解压器：透镜

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4123`

### English

Matter Decompressor: Lensing

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4450`

## mega.9011.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9011.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

建造于现有重力重定向系统之上，重力透镜设施能够使一部分力穿过“透镜”，将力更加密集地集中在某一片选中的区域。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4124`

### English

Built on the existing gravity redirection system, the Gravity Lensing Facility is able to redirect a portion of the force into a "Lens", concentrating the force even more strongly in a selected area.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4451`

## mega.9012.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9012.name&lang=en)

### 中文

物质解压器：钻孔

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4125`

### English

Matter Decompressor: Boring

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4452`

## mega.9012.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9012.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

从黑洞提取物质的关键就在于究极精致的重力重定向系统：在某个区域集中生成一片引力扭曲的区域，然后打造出一个专门用来应对重力情况下的大型重定向钻头。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4126`

### English

The key to extracting matter from the black hole is the ultimate refinement of the gravity redirection system: Forming a focused area of twisted gravity, in effect creating a vast drill whose bore is made of redirected and concentrated gravitational force.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4453`

## mega.9013.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9013.name&lang=en)

### 中文

物质解压器：萃取

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4127`

### English

Matter Decompressor: Extraction

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4454`

## mega.9013.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9013.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

物质解压器的最后一步看上去十分单调，但也有他最令人震撼的一面。一大堆自动化的冶炼厂以及处理器开始将采取自[From.GetName]的物质分解，解压缩并分离为实用的矿物，再装入连续不绝的机械驳船舰队中，送往帝国各地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4128`

### English

The final stage of the Matter Decompressor is the most mundane, but in its own way the most impressive. A vast automated array of smelters and processors break down, decompress, and separate the material of [From.GetName] into useful minerals which are decanted into an unending fleet of robotic barges to be delivered around our empire.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4455`

## cara.4110.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4110.name&lang=en)

### 中文

收藏家

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4129`

### English

The Collector

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4456`

## cara.4110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你好。我是一个收藏家，在这向你提供一个千载难逢的机会。我有一个盒子要出售，盒子当中有什么我不会泄露，我也不会给你看。你可以用3000£energy£能量币来买，然后不管里面有什么都归你了，但是一旦出手概不退换。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4130`

### English

Greetings. I am The Collector and I offer you an opportunity. I have a box for sale, a box obtained through means I will not divulge and with a content I shall not reveal. You may purchase this box for £energy£ 3000 and keep whatever it contains, but I offer no refunds.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4457`

## cara.4110.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4110.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你都不让我们知道箱子里面有什么就打算让我们付钱？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4131`

### English

You expect us to pay for this box with no idea of its contents?

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4458`

## cara.4150.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4150.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

绰尔的罗盘是一个专门找刺激的地方。由于经常光顾的原因，[cara_border_planet.GetName]的公民们对于周遭事物的冷静已经到了一个前所未有的水平。

## cara.4160.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4160.name&lang=en)

### 中文

巨尸乐队音乐会：百万雄尸！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4149`

### English

MegaCorpse Concert: Millions Dead!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4476`

## cara.4160.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4160.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[cara_border_planet.GetName]在灵能金属乐巨尸乐队的音乐会失控后陷入混乱。破坏面之广使得人们只能一点点拼凑出当时的情况。不过有一件可以确认的事情是，在演出高潮时科尔-阿赞在月球上打出了一个洞，将它给完全摧毁了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4150`

### English

[cara_border_planet.GetName] has been left in chaos after a concert by the Psi-Metal phenomenon Megacorpse got out of hand. Reports are scrambled due to the wide-spread devastation, but one thing they all agree on is that at the height of the performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan punched a hole in the moon, destroying it utterly.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4477`

## cara.4160.nomoon.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4160.nomoon.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[cara_border_planet.GetName]在灵能金属乐巨尸乐队的音乐会失控后陷入混乱。破坏面之广使得人们只能一点点拼凑出当时的情况。不过有一件可以确认的事情是，在演出高潮时科尔-阿赞把他的超级吉他重重地朝地上砸去，这导致了整个区域被完全破坏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4151`

### English

[cara_border_planet.GetName] has been left in chaos after a concert by the Psi-Metal phenomenon Megacorpse got out of hand. Reports are scrambled due to the wide-spread devastation, but one thing they all agree on is that at the height of the performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan slammed its hyper-guitar into the stage with such force the entire area was destroyed.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4478`

## cara.4161.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4161.name&lang=en)

### 中文

巨尸乐队：起源

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4153`

### English

MegaCorpse: Origins

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4480`

## cara.4161.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acara.4161.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

巨尸乐队是企业中最伟大的灵能金属乐队。传说那些形态迥异的乐队成员——科尔-阿赞，甘荃，人类，勇达尔，和塞可达瑞——互相之间通过虚境进行交流。\n\n这是真的。\n\n仅仅只有少数人知道，虚境是星河之声下辖的一个绝密的超声音乐研究部门的代号。星河之声在多元宇宙中引领着音乐潮流，同时也是声波武器制造商。巨尸乐队成立的初衷是作为灵能突击部队。他们会在棘手的“会场”进行“演奏”，通过将微弱的灵能攻击性抑制术埋藏在那些公然辱骂企业的歌词下进而影响听众，高效地暗中破坏叛乱行动。\n\n最后，音乐对于乐队成员那已经十分强大的灵能的催化效果实在过于强大，以至于不能被管理者们控制。成员们分道扬镳，只剩空壳乐队名——因为星河之声不愿意撕毁一个无比赚钱的合约。如今巨尸乐队走到哪弹到哪，只要他们觉得合适，只要那是§R金属乐§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4154`

### English

MegaCorpse is the greatest psionic-metal band in corporate space. It is said that the disparate bandmates -- Kel-Azaan, Gantren, Human, Yondar, and Scyldari -- made contact through the Shroud.\n\nThis is true.\n\nKnown only to a select few, the Shroud is the code-name of a top-secret sono-musical skunkworks division of Galactic Sounds, the leading music conglomerate and sonic weapons manufacturer in the multiverse. The MegaCorpse initiative was originally developed as a psionic strike force. They would "play" difficult "venues," effectively subverting rebellious movements with overtly anti-corporate lyrics disguising subtle psionic aggression-dampening measures inflicted on the listener.\n\nUltimately, the catalytic effects of their music on the band's already-potent psionic powers soon proved too much for managers and executives to control. The band went rogue in all but name - as Galactic Sounds were unwilling to break a fantastically profitable contract - and today MegaCorpse play whatever and wherever they see fit, as long as it is §Rmetal§!.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4481`

被毁的物质解压器

Ruined Matter Decompressor

## mega.9100.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9100.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]的视界线上不可思议地存在着某种采矿装置。我们的科学家认为这可能是一个“§H物质解压器§!”——用于从黑洞中开采矿物的巨型结构。尽管它已无法正常运转，但某些阻止它被意大利面条化的装置一定仍在运作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4157`

### English

Impossibly perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is some kind of mining apparatus. Our scientists theorize that this may be a "§HMatter Decompressor§!" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no longer fully functional, some mechanism preventing its spaghettification must still be operational.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4484`

## mega.9100.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.9100.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

位于[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]事件视界上的是一个“§H物质解压器§!”——一个从黑洞中获取矿物的巨型结构。即使机能不全，它的引力扭曲引擎一定仍在运作，否则它早就因为黑洞的引力变成一团意大利面条了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4158`

### English

Perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is a "§HMatter Decompressor§!" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no longer fully functional,  its gravitational twist engine must still be operational as it has not suffered spaghettification.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4485`

### 中文

我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它破碎的残骸中包含了大量的战斗计算机、模拟器、以及通讯阵列，因此我们的科学家认为这一定是某种“§H战略指挥中心§!”。

Its shattered remains contain a plenitude of battlecomputers, simulators, and broadcasting arrays which leads our scientists to speculate it must have been some type of "§HStrategic Coordination Center§!".

位于[From.GetName]的星际集会已经再次上线了。它已准备好再次迎接星系中的外交官们，共同商讨当前太阳周期中的问题。

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.3040.name&lang=en)

### 中文

窥探虚空

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4179`

### English

Probing the Void

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4506`

## colony.3040.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.3040.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在多年的研究之后，[Root.GetName]上的某些研究者们觉得自己开始理解太虚了。有一些……波动。力量。一股流动轻柔地通过传送门流向[From.GetName]，并带来我们可以收集的微量暗物质。从理论上讲，我们应该可以使我们的传送门对这股波动更加“显眼”，以此产生更多的暗物质。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4180`

### English

After years of study, some researchers on [Root.GetName] are beginning to feel they understand the Null Void. There are... currents. Forces. Some flow which gently pushes against the portal to [From.GetName], bringing the traces of Dark Matter we are able to collect. In theory it should be possible to make our portal more "visible" to this force, which should result in a larger harvest.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4507`

## colony.3041.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.3041.name&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4181`

### English

Calling the Void

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4508`

## colony.3041.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.3041.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一座巨大的信号增幅器将一道能量射入了[Root.GetName]上的传送门。效果立竿见影，传送门另一端的压力明显开始增加，并涌出了更多的暗物质流。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4182`

### English

A vast signal amplifier has sent a blast of energy through the portal on [Root.GetName]. The effect was immediate, the pressure on the far side of the portal is noticeably stronger, and with it comes an increased flow of Dark Matter.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4509`

## action.96.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.96.name&lang=en)

### 中文

§H泛星系贸易市场的诞生§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4207`

### English

§HBirth of the Galactic Market§!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4536`

## action.96.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.96.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自从我们意识到自己不是寰宇之中的孤独之身后，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。随着星系的边境线被不断刷新，旧的商路也不断重绘，星际领袖们同意应该§Y使这种贸易市场合法化§!，让大家都可从中受益。\n\n在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如果该贸易中心坐落于[Root.GetAdj]境内，一定会使我们受益，因此我们可以§Y宣传我们的一颗星球§!作为位置候选。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4208`

### English

De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is time to §Ylegitimize this commercial forum§! so that all may benefit.\n\nIn the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. We would surely benefit were this hub to fall within [Root.GetAdj] space, so we can choose to §Ypromote one of our worlds§! for this purpose.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4537`

## action.96.desc.corp

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.96.desc.corp&lang=en)

### 中文

星际消费者们，客户们还有各位乡巴佬们，终于准备好迎接一个准中心化的平台进行轻监管的、中等规模的国际贸易。\n\n我们可以§Y提名一个我们的星球§!成为贸易枢纽，通过这种方式以获得最大化的潜在收入。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4209`

### English

The customers, clients, and rubes of the galaxy at long last seem ready to accept a quasi-centralized platform for deregulated, mid-scale international commerce.\n\nWe can §Ypromote one of our worlds§! to play host to this commercial hub, to maximize potential revenue.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4538`

## action.96.desc.phobe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.96.desc.phobe&lang=en)

### 中文

遗憾的是，我们一直未能有效地打击§Y与异种社会的违法贸易§!。同样令人遗憾的是，这一不受外交关系影响而且几乎匿名的贸易市场带来了实实在在的利润。\n\n在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如能主导此贸易中心的运营，想必一定会比囤积外星货物要有用得多，因此我们可以§Y宣传我们的一颗星球§!作为位置候选。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4210`

### English

It is a regrettable fact that we have consistently failed to quash the illicit §Ytrade with the xenos§!. Equally regrettable is that the economic benefits of a largely anonymous forum for trade decoupled from international relations cannot be denied.\n\nIn the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. The economic gains from playing host to such a nexus might well outweigh the burden of harboring alien goods, so we can choose to §Ypromote one of our worlds§! for this purpose.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4539`

## action.96.desc.homicidal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.96.desc.homicidal&lang=en)

尽管很少有人愿意与我们直接进行贸易，星海之中一直存在着一个繁荣的黑市，而我们终于可以利用它了

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4211`

### English

While few are willing to trade with us directly, there exists a thriving galactic black market that we have finally managed to tap into.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4540`

### English

## action.1000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

很不幸，我们发起的建立泛星系贸易市场的动议§Y碰壁了§!。虽然我们明显成功地为该计划调动了政治意愿，但却没收到任何有效的主办地提名。\n\n原则上，商业说客和政治拥趸都支持这个想法，并发誓会加倍努力，只要[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]希望再次尝试。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4223`

### English

Our motion to bring forth a new Galactic Market has unfortunately §Yfailed§!. While we clearly succeeded in mustering the political will for such a scheme, it did not receive any valid nominations for a host site.\n\nCommercial lobbyists and political proponents alike stand by the idea in principle, having vowed to redouble their efforts should the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] wish to try again.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4552`

## action.1000.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1000.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们拭目以待吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4224`

### English

We shall have to see.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4553`

## action.1005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

看来星系的市场范围无法承载其政治意图。苦于缺乏有效的主办地提名，最近 [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]为构建专门的交易中心而做出的努力都§Y白费了§!。\n\n泛星系贸易市场计划的支持者们旋即表明一点都不觉得尴尬，声称只要[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]认为时机成熟，他们将再次提出自己的主张。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4225`

### English

It would seem the galaxy's political will has exceeded the reach of its markets. Recent efforts by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to establish a dedicated trading hub have §Yfailed§!, with no valid nominations for a host site.\n\nProponents of the Galactic Market scheme were quick to deny any hint of embarrassment, declaring that they will make their case again whenever the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] considers itself ready.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4554`

## action.1005.desc.phobe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1005.desc.phobe&lang=en)

### 中文

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的市场范围无法承载其政治意图，因为最近他们为形成统一的泛星系贸易市场而做出的努力都§Y白费了§!。到头来，异种人备受推崇的项目连一个有效的主办地提名都没能吸引到。\n\n计划的支持者否认这表明异星人的“合作”想法是弄巧成拙。相反，他们坚定地宣称，如果星系的成员认为时机成熟了，可以再次尝试。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4226`

### English

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s political will has exceeded the reach of its markets, as their recent effort to form a unified Galactic Market has §Yfailed§!. After all was said and done, the xenos' much-vaunted project couldn't entice a single valid nomination for a host site.\n\nProponents of the scheme have denied that this exposes the true folly behind ideas about xeno 'collaboration'. Instead they are resolute in claims that the galaxy may try again, when its members consider themselves ready.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4555`

## action.101.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.101.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

泛星系贸易中心已被设立在§Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系，位于[From.GetName]境内。[From.GetAdj]政府已经正式宣布这一市场合法，资源已经可以通过中立第三方进行买卖。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4229`

### English

The center of galactic commerce has manifested in the §Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§! system, within the borders of the [From.GetName]. The [From.GetAdj] administration has officially legitimized this marketplace, where resources can be bought and sold through unaffiliated third parties.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4558`

## action.101.desc.phobe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.101.desc.phobe&lang=en)

### 中文

心怀鬼胎的§Y[From.GetName]§!异种建立了一个外星商品的交易市场。尽管我们对此不屑一顾，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4230`

### English

## action.106.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.106.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过新的联系，我们已经获得了通过泛星系贸易市场进行资源买卖的权利。这一定会刺激[Root.GetAdj]经济。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4235`

### English

Through our newly-established contacts, we have gained access to a galactic marketplace for the purchase and sale of resources. This will surely be a great boon to the [Root.GetAdj] economy.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4564`

## action.106.desc.phobe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.106.desc.phobe&lang=en)

### 中文

我们得知恶心的异种们建立了一个交易外星商品的星系市场。尽管我们不愿涉足其中，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4236`

### English

We have learned of a galactic marketplace for the trade of alien goods, established by the loathsome xenos. While we are naturally reluctant to take part in this exchange, the option is now available to us.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4565`

## distar.305.rare_crystals

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adistar.305.rare_crystals&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]在[FromFrom.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H$rare_crystals$§!。这些水晶优异的衍射特性使其极为适合用来制作电子元件或是打造激光武器系统。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4239`

### English

The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource on [FromFrom.GetName], dubbed §H$rare_crystals$§!. The crystals lend themselves well to both high-end electronics as well as laser weapons systems, thanks to their spectacular refractive properties.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4569`

## distar.305.exotic_gases

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adistar.305.exotic_gases&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]在[FromFrom.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H$exotic_gases$§!。这些气体不但可以用来作战甚至还可以作为消遣性毒品使用。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4240`

### English

The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource on [FromFrom.GetName], dubbed §H$exotic_gases$§!. These gases have a number of tactical and even recreational uses.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4570`

## distar.305.volatile_motes

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adistar.305.volatile_motes&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]在[FromFrom.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H$volatile_motes$§!。这些微尘被化学激活后能够在爆炸中释放出大量动能，据说如果用来做菜的话还会很辣。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4241`

### English

The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource on [FromFrom.GetName], dubbed §H$volatile_motes$§!. These particles produce an explosive amount of kinetic force when chemically activated, and are supposedly very spicy when used in cooking.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4571`

## decision_market_nomination_effects

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adecision_market_nomination_effects&lang=en)

### 中文

基于当地状况，为星球添加§Y基础市场竞争力评分§!修正。评分越高，星球就越有可能被§H泛星系贸易市场§!选中。\n\n最好提名一颗产出许多贸易额的星球，以提高其被选中的可能性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4243`

### English

Applies a §YBase Marketplace Competitiveness Rating§! modifier to the planet, according to its local conditions. The better the rating, the more likely the planet will play host to the future §HGalactic Market§!.\n\nIt is best to nominate a planet which produces a lot of trade, as that will make it more likely to be chosen.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4574`

## decision_market_nomination_effects_short

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adecision_market_nomination_effects_short&lang=en)

### English

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4575`

## decision_market_nomination_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adecision_market_nomination_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

成为星系贸易的枢纽可谓名利双收。市场风云莫测，但只要给出足够的津贴，我们或许可以引诱贸易巨头们进驻这颗星球。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4245`

### English

Being the nexus of galactic trade is a position as prestigious as it is profitable. The market is fickle, but with enough incentives we might be able to lure the big players to establish themselves on this planet.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4576`

## mega.100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amega.100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们失去了[From.GetName]星系内的祝圣之物！\n\n悲痛与沉重的失落笼罩了[Root.GetAdj]的殖民地。不同于一个星球被宣布不再为神所庇佑，这种对心灵依靠的以暴力手段无情践踏否定的行为让[Root.GetName]的信徒们陷入震惊与迷茫。神职人员决定进行五年的哀悼。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4256`

### English

We have lost access to the objects of worship in the [From.GetName] system!\n\nGrief and a profound sense of loss grips the [Root.GetAdj] colonies. Different from a world being declared unconsecrated, this violent denial of spiritual agency leaves the believers of [Root.GetName] shell-shocked and disoriented. The clergy have decreed a half-decade of mourning.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4588`

## market_founding_end_regular

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarket_founding_end_regular&lang=en)

### 中文

\n\n如果我们希望竞争市场东道主的头衔，可以在几年的时间里使用§H决议§!来提名我们的一个星球主持$galactic_market_station$。

## market_founding_end_nomadic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarket_founding_end_nomadic&lang=en)

## building_waste_reprocessing_center_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_waste_reprocessing_center_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星球的一站式回收中心，可将工业和生物废物转换成可重新利用的清洁能源和矿物。它由$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$设计，其构造很神秘，而且大部分无法逆向工程。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4478`

### English

A planet's one stop center for converting industrial and bio-waste into mostly clean, mostly reusable energy and minerals. Designed by the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, its construction is somewhat arcane, and largely non-reverse- engineerable.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4844`

## DEMAND_SUBS_SELECT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADEMAND_SUBS_SELECT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你是否要提议[Root.GetName]成为你的子公司？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4481`

### English

## DEMAND_SUBS_ACCEPT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADEMAND_SUBS_ACCEPT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

作为您的子公司，[Root.GetName]将向您上供其部分贸易额。作为交换，我们期望你捍卫[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的生命，自由和独立。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4482`

### English

As your subsidiary, the [Root.GetName] will share some of its trade with you. In exchange we expect you to defend the defend the life, liberty and independence of the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4850`

## DEMAND_SUBS_REFUSE_01

[Root.GetName]无论什么情况下都不愿意成为[From.GetSpeciesAdj]剥削对象。

## ASK_FOR_SUBS_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AASK_FOR_SUBS_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]需要军事保护。请让我们成为[From.GetAdj]的子公司，作为您忠诚的下属，我们将会在我们的贸易中为您提供分成。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4484`

### English

The [Root.GetName] is in need of military protection. Make us a subsidiary under [From.GetAdj] rule and we, as your loyal subject, will offer you a substantial portion of our trade.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4852`

## TO_CORP_DOW_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATO_CORP_DOW_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]对于所有智慧生物来说都是威胁。在我们的星系道德沦丧之前必须清除你这些庸脂俗粉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4504`

### English

[Root.GetName] is a threat to all sapient life. The galaxy must be purged of your tawdry wares before it succumbs to complete moral decline.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4872`

## TO_CORP_DOW_PROPOSE_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATO_CORP_DOW_PROPOSE_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]不会再容忍你卑鄙的行径，同时也不会允许你再剥削星系中的共有资源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4505`

### English

The [From.GetName] will no longer stand for your underhanded practices and unconscionable exploitation of common galactic assets.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4873`

## TO_CORP_DOW_PROPOSE_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATO_CORP_DOW_PROPOSE_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]的出现就是对品味的冒犯。我们无法容忍你再出现在星系之中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4506`

### English

The [Root.GetName] brand is an affront to good taste. We can no longer tolerate your presence in the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4874`

## TO_CORP_DOW_PROPOSE_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATO_CORP_DOW_PROPOSE_04&lang=en)

### 中文

## CORP_WAR_GREETING_04

## CORP_CORP_WAR_GREETING_02

## CORP_VASSAL_GREETING_01

## CORP_DEMAND_SUBS_PROPOSE_02

## CORP_DEMAND_SUBS_ACCEPT_01

### 中文

## CORP_DEMAND_PROT_REFUSE_01

## CORP_ASK_FOR_PROT_PROPOSE_01

## 02_FORM_COMMERCIAL_PACT_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_FORM_COMMERCIAL_PACT_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

你可曾觉得你的生活尽是些你不得不做的而不是你想要做的吗，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？在[From.GetName]这儿，我们存在的意义就是完成那些你不愿做的事情，因此你也不必做这些事。与我们签订商业合约，让你的存在更加有意义！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/megacorp_l_simp_chinese.yml:4626`

### English

Ever feel like your life is all about the have-tos and never about the want-tos, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Here at [From.GetName] we live for doing the things you don't want to, so you don't have to. Enter a commercial pact with us and maximize the meaningfulness of your existence!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4995`

## 03_FORM_COMMERCIAL_PACT_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_FORM_COMMERCIAL_PACT_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

在[From.GetName]这儿，我们一直坚持以多换少，今天我们有一个你无法拒绝的交易。一个商业协议……我俩之间的！怎么样，无法拒绝吧！

### English

Here at [From.GetName] we consistently deliver more for less, and today we would like to offer you a deal you simply cannot refuse. A commercial pact... with us! Tell us you can't refuse!

Source: `localisation/english/megacorp_l_english.yml:4996`
